schemes.scheme_name: Bhraman - Darshan Yojana
schemes.description: The Bhraman-Darshan Yojana, launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, Government of Bihar, aims to educate fish farmers on the latest fisheries techniques. It provides a two-day educational tour within the state to 12,000 fish farmers, enabling them to adopt modern technologies in their water sources.
objectives: To educate fish farmers in Bihar about the latest fisheries techniques.
To enable fish farmers to adopt and implement modern technologies in their water sources.
To increase fish production, productivity, and the annual income of fish farmers.

benefits.description: Increased awareness and inspiration to adopt latest fisheries techniques and modern technologies.
Increase in fish production, productivity, and annual income for fish farmers.
Creation of new employment opportunities within the fisheries sector.

schemes.eligibility_description: The fish farmer must be a resident of Bihar, work in private, leased, or government ponds/watersheds, and be an active member of Block Level Fishermen Cooperation Committees. Progressive fish farmers trained under departmental schemes are eligible, as are those who want to do fish farming with adequate resources. Benefits can be availed only once.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and click on the application link for the financial year (2024-25).
2. Select "Registration for Fisheries Schemes" and complete basic details for registration, including category, caste, name, date of birth, address, and bank details.
3. Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number, verify with OTP, and receive a Registration Number and Password.
4. Log in using the Registration Number and Password.
5. Select the scheme name under the "Marai Training Scheme" option and provide personal, permanent address, and experience details.
6. Upload required documents (photo, ID, educational, pre-training certificates) and submit the application to generate a receipt.
schemes.ministry: Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojna
schemes.description: The Bihar State Crop Assistance Scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Bihar whose crops are damaged due to natural calamities like floods or drought. It aims to protect the agricultural produce of cultivators across the state. Farmers receive aid based on the extent of yield reduction caused by such disasters.
objectives: To protect the crops of farmers in Bihar from natural calamities.
To provide financial assistance to farmers for crop damage caused by natural disasters.
To support the agricultural sector and ensure financial stability for farmers in Bihar.

benefits.description: Total assistance of Rs. 15,000 (Rs. 7,500 per hectare) for a maximum of two hectares, in case of a 20% reduction in actual yield rate compared to the threshold.
Total assistance of Rs. 20,000 (Rs. 10,000 per hectare) for a maximum of two hectares, in case of more than a 20% reduction in actual yield rate compared to the threshold.

schemes.eligibility_description: All farmers cultivating their own land, others' land, or both, within the state of Bihar, are eligible for this scheme.
schemes.application_process:
1. Farmers need to register on https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/ if they don't have a registration number.
2. Log in to the official portal using their registration details.
3. If needed, search for the registration number on https://pacsonline.bih.nic.in/fsy/Register.aspx.
4. A new form will open where applicants must enter the required information.
5. Submit the application online.

documents_required.name: Self-declaration certificate (attested by ward member/farmer advisor)

schemes.ministry: Bihar State Government

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: The Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana, a component of the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, aims to promote commercial cultivation of horticultural crops. It specifically focuses on increasing dragon fruit cultivation across 21 districts in the state. The scheme provides financial assistance to ryot farmers for this purpose.
objectives: Promote commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in Bihar.
Increase the cultivation area of dragon fruit across 21 specified districts.
Provide financial assistance to ryot farmers for dragon fruit cultivation.

benefits.description: Financial support for dragon fruit cultivation, disbursed over three years: ₹1,80,000/- per hectare in the first year, and ₹60,000/- per hectare in the second and third years.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be ryot farmers residing in Bihar, specifically from one of the 21 listed districts. They must possess agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 10 acres (4 ha) and be registered on the DBT portal.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and click 'Proceed to apply'.
2. Select 'Type of Applicant' and enter the 'DBT Registration Number of Kisan' to get details.
3. Fill in required details such as Address and Land Details.
4. Upload all necessary documents.
5. Confirm the checkbox and click 'Submit'.
6. An 'Application Number' will be generated for future reference.

documents_required.name: Genealogy (if applicant's name is unclear in land documents)

schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Kela Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: The Kela Vikas Yojana, a component of the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, promotes commercial cultivation of horticultural crops. It specifically supports plantain cultivation across 15 districts by providing financial aid and quality tissue-cultured plants. The scheme ensures inclusivity with reserved quotas for SC, ST, and women beneficiaries, and is open to both ryot and non-ryot farmers.
objectives: To promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar.
To support plantain cultivation across 15 specific districts in Bihar.
To provide financial assistance and quality tissue-cultured plants to farmers.

benefits.description: Financial assistance of ₹46,875/- per hectare in the first year and ₹15,625/- per hectare in the second year.
Supply of high-quality tissue-cultured plants for banana cultivation.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar, a farmer, and from one of the 15 specified districts (Arwal, Bhojpur, Buxar, Gopalganj, Jehanabad, Kaimur, Lakhisarai, Madhepura, Nawada, Saran, Shivhar, Sitamarhi, Siwan, Supaul, Sheikhpura). They must possess agricultural land between a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha) and be registered on the DBT portal. Both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register on the DBT portal by providing Aadhaar details, farmer information, land details, and bank account details.
2. Obtain a 13-digit DBT registration number after 48 hours.
3. Visit the official scheme website and proceed to apply.
4. Select applicant type, enter DBT Registration Number, and fetch details.
5. Fill in required details (address, land), upload documents, and submit the application.
6. Note down the generated Application Number for future reference.

documents_required.name: Genealogy (if applicant's name is unclear on land documents)

schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana
schemes.description: The Krishi Input Anudan Yojana, launched by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, provides agricultural input subsidies to farmers. It targets areas affected by rising water levels in rivers like the Ganga and Kosi, offering assistance for crop damage exceeding 33% due to heavy rainfall and flooding. The scheme aims to support farmers in recovering from natural calamities.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to farmers affected by crop damage due to floods and heavy rainfall.
To support agricultural input costs in areas impacted by rising river water levels.
To ensure that genuine cultivators receive subsidies for their losses.

benefits.description: Farmers receive subsidies for crop damage exceeding 33% due to floods. Non-irrigated areas receive ₹8,500/hectare (minimum ₹1,000), irrigated areas ₹17,000/hectare (minimum ₹2,000), and perpetual/perennial crops ₹22,500/hectare (minimum ₹2,500).

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be farmers belonging to reported Panchayats of identified blocks in specified districts of Bihar. They must be registered on the DBT portal, and their bank account must be linked with their Aadhaar number. Farmers cultivating on others' land require joint certification as 'actual cultivators'.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the DBT portal for registration and select Aadhaar verification type.
2. Enter Aadhaar details, confirm KCC details, and complete farmer registration.
3. After 48 hours, visit the official website and click 'Apply Online'.
4. Select the 'Agricultural Input Subsidy Scheme' from the dropdown.
5. Enter the 13-digit registration number, fill in details, and verify OTP.
6. Upload required documents and submit the application.

documents_required.name: Land document (Receipt / Jamabandi) or Land Possession Certificate (LPC)
Details of Crop Damaged by the flood
Details of two adjacent farmers and verified documents (Applicant’s) with their signatures

schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Makhana Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: The Makhana Vikas Yojana, launched by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, aims to boost Makhana cultivation and productivity in 10 designated districts. It focuses on offering training to farmers and providing grants for traditional equipment used in cultivation and processing. The scheme targets farmers with agricultural land in specific districts of Bihar.
objectives: To enhance the cultivation and productivity of Makhana in 10 districts of Bihar.
To provide training to farmers on modern methods for Makhana cultivation.
To offer financial assistance for traditional equipment used in Makhana cultivation and processing.

benefits.description: Workshops and training for farmers to adopt modern methods and improve Makhana productivity.
Grants covering 75% of the cost, up to ₹16,575, for traditional tools used in Makhana cultivation and processing.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be farmers residing in one of the 10 designated districts of Bihar (Katihar, Purnia, Darbhanga, Madhubani, Kishanganj, Supaul, Araria, Madhepura, Saharsa, Khagaria). They must possess agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 10 acres (4 ha) and be registered on the DBT portal. Women participation is targeted at 30%.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register on the DBT portal by providing Aadhaar details, farmer information, land details, and bank account.
2. After 48 hours of DBT registration, visit the official scheme website.
3. Select applicant type, enter DBT Registration Number, and retrieve details.
4. Fill in required details like address and land information, then upload necessary documents.
5. Confirm details and submit the application to generate an Application Number.
schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana
schemes.description: The "Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana" is a Bihar government scheme launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources Department. It aims to renovate 150 hectares of private ponds to increase fish productivity and production. The scheme specifically allocates resources for extremely backward castes, scheduled castes, and scheduled tribes, ensuring inclusive growth and support for marginalized communities.
objectives: Increase Water Holding Capacity: Enhance the water holding capacity of private ponds to boost fish productivity and production.
Economic Benefits for Fish Farmers: Provide benefits to private fish farmers through the expansion/renovation of their ponds.
Promote Inclusive Growth: Ensure support for marginalized communities, including extremely backward castes, scheduled castes, and scheduled tribes.

benefits.description: Renovation of 150 hectares of private ponds, with specific targets for different beneficiary categories.
Unit cost of ₹ 6,00,000/- per hectare for pond renovation.
30% subsidy for other categories, and 40% for extremely backward castes/scheduled castes/tribes on the unit cost, disbursed in two installments.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a fish farmer and a private pond owner or lessee. Ponds must not have been renovated under any government scheme in the last five years, unless it's a pond constructed under a government scheme where benefits are payable after five years of construction.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and click on the application link for the financial year (2024-25).
2. Select "Registration for Fisheries Schemes" and complete basic details for registration, including category, caste, name, DOB, address, and bank details.
3. Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number, verify with OTP, and receive a Registration Number and Password.
4. Log in using the provided Registration Number and Password.
5. Select the scheme under the "Matsya Yojana" option and provide individual, address, bank, and land/pond details.
6. Upload required documents, submit the form online, print the application form, and submit it to the District Fisheries Office along with attachments and required affidavits.

documents_required.name: Clear Photograph of the Proposed Pond with a Distinguishable Landmark
Land Ownership Certificate or Lease Agreement (minimum 9 years for leased land)
Bank Account Number, Branch, IFSC code Details
Caste Certificate (for extremely backward castes/scheduled castes/scheduled tribes)
Affidavit stating that the pond has not been renovated under any government scheme in the last five years

schemes.ministry: Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana is a component of the umbrella Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana, launched by the Department of Industries, Bihar. It aims to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among individuals from Minority communities in the state. The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000 for establishing and operating business ventures, fostering economic growth and empowerment.
objectives: To promote entrepreneurship among individuals from all categories in Bihar.
To encourage self-employment opportunities across the state.
To foster economic growth and empowerment specifically within Minority communities through business ventures.

benefits.description: Receive up to ₹10,00,000 for setting up a business. This includes a non-repayable grant of up to ₹5,00,000 (50%) and an interest-free loan of up to ₹5,00,000 (50%), with a nominal 1% interest under specific sub-schemes.
Mandatory training sessions are provided to enhance entrepreneurial skills for applicants.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant should have passed at least 10+2, Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or equivalent. The business unit must be a proprietorship or partnership firm.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website, click "Registration/Log in", and select "Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana" as "MMUY".
2. Enter your Aadhaar number, create a password, and click "Login".
3. Fill in the registration form carefully and click "Submit".
4. After successful registration, log in to the portal using your Aadhaar number and password.
5. Fill the application form accurately with all necessary details and upload required documents.
6. Review the application, click "Submit", and download the acknowledgment receipt for your records.
schemes.ministry: Department of Industries, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
schemes.description: The BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School scheme, launched by the BC & EBC Welfare Department, Government of Bihar, aims to provide quality education with modern facilities. It operates high schools across all 38 districts of the state. The scheme focuses on the educational and overall development of girl students from backward and extremely backward classes.
objectives: To provide quality education with modern facilities in a safe and natural environment.
To support the educational and overall development of girl students.
To cater specifically to girl students from backward and extremely backward classes.

benefits.description: Free enrolment, accommodation, food, and sacks are provided.
Amount for clothes, books, medicine, and cleaning is paid to girl students through DBT.
Modern laboratories, Jananayak Library, Digital Study Centre, competitive books, 24-hour power, clubs, career guidance, and educational tours are offered.
Vocational training, skill development, and horticulture facilities are available.

eligibility.caste: Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC)

schemes.eligibility_description: The scheme is for girl students from Class 6 to Class 12, who are residents of Bihar and belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC). An entrance examination is required for selection into Classes VI, VII, VIII, and IX. The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹3,00,000.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and register by providing personal details, Aadhaar, mobile number, and setting a password.
2. Log in with the generated User ID and password to access the application form.
3. Complete personal and education details, including Aadhaar and address proof.
4. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, birth certificate, caste, income, and residential certificates.
5. Enter the advertisement number along with details of three schools.
6. Accept the Terms & Conditions and click on "Final Submit" to receive an application number.
schemes.ministry: BC & EBC Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Evam Anusuchit Janjati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Evam Anusuchit Janjati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana, launched by the SC and ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance and facilities to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students residing in hostels. It aims to support their higher education by covering hostel-related needs and increasing awareness among weaker sections of society.
objectives: To provide financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month to eligible SC/ST students residing in hostels.
To furnish essential facilities like cot, mattress, table, chair, and cooking utensils to students in hostels.
To promote higher education among students from weaker sections and fulfill their hostel-related needs.

benefits.description: Monthly grant of ₹1,000 for students residing in Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe hostels.
Provision of essential items like cot, mattress, bed-sheet, table, chair, and kitchen utensils in hostels.

schemes.eligibility_description: The student must be a resident of Bihar, belong to Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe, be enrolled in a recognized course and educational institution, and reside in a hostel operated by the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Welfare Department.
schemes.application_process:
1. Request a hard copy of the application form from the Hostel Superintendent or write an application on plain paper.
2. Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the required documents to the Hostel Superintendent.
3. The Hostel Superintendent will upload the list of students and related information to the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Welfare Department portal.

documents_required.name: Proof of Enrolment in a Recognized Educational Institution

schemes.ministry: SC and ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana, launched by the Department of Education, Bihar, provides a lump sum incentive of ₹25,000/- to girl students. It aims to promote higher education and empower girls by making them self-reliant. Beneficiaries must have graduated from recognized institutions within Bihar after April 25, 2018.
objectives: To promote higher education among girl students.
To empower girls by fostering self-reliance.
To provide financial assistance to girl graduates in Bihar.

benefits.description: A one-time allowance of ₹25,000/- is awarded to eligible girl students upon graduation.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar and have graduated or obtained an equivalent degree after April 25, 2018, from a government-recognized or affiliated institution within Bihar. The scheme applies to graduates from general, technical, or professional courses. The applicant must have a bank account in a nationalized, recognized private, or India Postal Payment Bank located in Bihar.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the registration page, enter mandatory details, create a new password, and validate the Captcha code.
2. Click “Submit” to generate the login ID and Password.
3. Visit the login page, enter mandatory details, and upload all required documents.
4. Recheck all entries before final submission, as no modifications can be made afterward.
5. Click “Submit” and take a printout of the submitted application.

documents_required.name: First Page of Bank Pass Book

schemes.ministry: Department of Education, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana, launched by the Backward and Extremely Backward Class Welfare Department, Government of Bihar, aims to encourage academic excellence. It provides a one-time financial incentive to students from extremely backward classes. This incentive is for those who have passed the 10th class (Matric) examination in the first division from the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB).
objectives: To encourage academic excellence among students belonging to extremely backward classes.
To provide a one-time financial incentive to eligible students.
To support students who pass the 10th class (Matric) examination in the first division from BSEB.

benefits.description: A one-time scholarship of ₹10,000/- is provided per student via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar, belong to the Extremely Backward Class (BC-I) category, and have passed the 10th class (Matric) examination in the first division from the Bihar School Examination Board, Patna.
schemes.application_process:
1. Eligible students contact their respective schools.
2. Schools ensure the availability of required documents.
3. The Bihar School Examination Board provides the list of eligible students to the Education Department.
4. Documents and identity of eligible students are verified by concerned authorities.
5. The authorized officer of the Education Department verifies and approves the disbursement.

documents_required.name: Copy of Bank Passbook/Bank account details

schemes.ministry: Backward and Extremely Backward Class Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
schemes.description: The Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme provides financial aid to students to complete their higher education. Students can avail loans of up to ₹4 lakhs at minimal interest rates for courses like B.Sc, B.A, B.Tech, or MBBS. This scheme targets students interested in higher education but lacking financial resources.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to students for pursuing higher education.
To enable students to access various polytechnic, technical, and general courses.
To support students from Bihar who face financial constraints in completing their studies.

benefits.description: Maximum loan amount of ₹4 lakh for higher education expenses.
Loan covers polytechnic, technical, and general courses including B.Sc, B.A, B.Tech, and MBBS.
Funds can be utilized for course fees, purchasing books, and laptops.
Flexible repayment starts after course completion and job securing; 1% interest for Divyang, transgender, and girl students.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of Bihar, at least 25 years old, and have passed class 12th. They must secure admission to an authorized institute for a course and commit to completing the entire course.
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit the official website 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in and register as a new applicant. 2. Log in with received credentials, fill personal information, and select the 'BSCC' option to apply. 3. Complete and submit the BSCC form; an acknowledgement number will be displayed. 4. Attend the scheduled appointment at the District Registration and Counseling Center (DRCC) with self-attested documents for verification. 5. Collect the 'Student Credit Card' and loan sanction letter from DRCC after verification and bank approval. 6. Visit the bank to complete documentation formalities and receive loan disbursement.

documents_required.name: Xth and XIIth mark sheet and certificate
Proof of residence (Passport, ID, driving license, Voter ID)

schemes.ministry: Department of Education

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana, launched by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Bihar, aims to provide employment opportunities to men and women aged 18 to 45 from the minority community. It offers vocational skill training in various fields or provides loans for self-employment under the "Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana" through the Bihar State Minority Financial Corporation, Patna.
objectives: To provide employment opportunities to men and women from the minority community.
To offer vocational skill training in various fields based on local employment demand.
To facilitate self-employment by providing loans through the Bihar State Minority Financial Corporation.

benefits.description: Enhances chances of self-employment and job opportunities through vocational training.
Candidates can avail loans at simple interest rates through the "Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana" after completing their training.
Trainees receive free study materials and tool kits from the institutes.

A stipend of ₹1500/- per month is provided if residential facilities are not available; otherwise, accommodation and food fees are paid directly to the institution by the Bihar State Minorities Financial Corporation Limited.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar, belong to a minority community, and have an annual family income less than ₹4,50,000/-. Minimum educational qualification for most training courses is 8th/10th pass, determined by the Bihar State Minorities Financial Corporation Limited. There is a 30% reservation for women and 3% for disabled persons.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website: https://bsmfc.org/
2. Click on 'Apply for Skill Training' and then 'Click Here to Apply'.
3. New users click 'New Registration', complete the form, and register.
4. Login with your User ID and Password.
5. Provide personal details, educational qualifications, select the training trade, and fill in training details.
6. Upload your photograph, signature, and other required documents, then submit the application.
schemes.ministry: Minority Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Bihar Disability Pension Scheme
schemes.description: The Bihar Disability Pension Scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹400/- to persons with a disability of 40% or more. It targets individuals not covered under the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme. The scheme offers social security regardless of the applicant's income or age.
objectives: To provide social security to the differently-abled section of poor families.
To offer financial assistance to persons with disabilities.
To support those with disabilities who are not covered by other national schemes.

benefits.description: Eligible differently-abled persons receive a monthly pension of ₹400/-. The amount is transferred directly into beneficiaries' accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar or have resided in Bihar for at least the past 10 years. They must possess a disability certificate with a minimum of 40% disability and should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme. There is no age or income limit for this scheme.
schemes.application_process:
1. Submit a duly filled and signed application in the prescribed format with required attachments at the Right to Public Service (RTPS) counter at the block office level.
2. Receive an acknowledgment receipt from the RTPS counter.
3. Applicants will be notified of the application's approval or rejection via SMS or email.
4. If approved, collect the Sanction Order from the same RTPS counter upon presenting the acknowledgment receipt and a valid identity card.

documents_required.name: Identity proof (Voter ID Card, Driving License)

schemes.ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal)
schemes.description: The Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal) aims to provide quick welfare benefits to disabled individuals across various state government disability schemes. It seeks to increase awareness, ensure rights, and empower Divyangjan physically, socially, educationally, and economically. The scheme is fully funded by the Bihar state government.
objectives: To provide quick benefits for the welfare of the disabled through state government schemes.
To increase awareness towards the disabled and ensure their rights.
To empower disabled individuals physically, socially, educationally, and economically.

benefits.description: A loan of up to Rs. 2.00 lakh will be provided for self-employment initiatives.
Scholarships will be given for teaching in special schools, at a rate less than that for non-disabled individuals.
Grants and state supplementary grants will be payable for participation in schemes of the National Trust, based on scheme needs and beneficiary specifics.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Divyangjan. Age limits vary by benefit: 18-60 years for self-employment loans, more than 5 years for artificial limbs and equipment, 6-18 years for special school students, and a minimum of 18 years for shelter homes. In very special cases involving multiple disabilities or judgments, there will be no restriction on income or age limits.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website.
2. Complete mandatory registration for e-filling the form.
3. Log in using your credentials.
4. Fill out the form with personal details, ensuring eligibility as per guidelines.
5. Upload your photo and signature.
6. Upload all required documents.
7. Finalize and submit your application.
schemes.ministry: Bihar State Government

schemes.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Bihar
schemes.description: The Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme, introduced in Bihar in 2009-10, provides monthly financial support to persons with disabilities. It targets individuals aged 18 to 79 years who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. The scheme aims to offer social security and financial assistance to the disabled from poor families.
objectives: To provide social security to persons with disabilities belonging to poor families.
To offer financial assistance to support persons with disabilities.
To ensure financial stability for disabled individuals in the age group of 18 to 79 years.

benefits.description: Eligible beneficiaries will receive a monthly pension of ₹400/- directly transferred to their accounts via DBT.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar, a person with 80% or more disability, and aged between 18 and 79 years. They must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family and not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.
schemes.application_process:
1. Submit the duly filled application form with required attachments at the Right to Public Service (RTPS) counter at the block office level.
2. Receive an acknowledgment receipt from the RTPS counter for future reference.
3. Await notification of application approval or rejection via SMS or email.
4. If approved, collect the Sanction Order from the same RTPS counter by presenting the acknowledgment receipt and a valid identity card.

documents_required.name: Identity proof (e.g., Voter ID Card, Driving License)
Below Poverty Line (BPL) Card/ Ration Card

schemes.ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme
schemes.description: The Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme, launched by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance to leprosy patients. It targets individuals with Visible Deformities Grade-II residing in the state. The scheme is fully funded by the state government.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to leprosy patients in the state.
To support individuals with Visible Deformities Grade-II.
To improve the welfare of leprosy patients in Bihar.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to leprosy patients with Visible Deformities Grade-II.

eligibility.disability: Leprosy patient with Visible Deformities Grade-II

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar and a leprosy patient with Visible Deformities Grade-II.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the application form in the prescribed format.
2. Fill out the application form with all required details.
3. Submit the completed application along with necessary documents at the respective block office.
4. The application will be approved by the Block Development Officer at the block level.

documents_required.name: Identity proof (e.g., Voter ID Card, Driving License)
Medical reports/documents related to Visible Deformities Grade –II

schemes.ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage (BBOCWWB)
schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance for Marriage" scheme, implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, provides ₹50,000 to registered male or female workers. This aid is for the marriage of their two adult daughters or for the female member's own marriage. Workers must have been Board members for at least three years and not be remarrying to be eligible.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for the marriage expenses of registered construction workers' daughters.
To support female construction workers with financial aid for their own marriage.
To promote the welfare of registered building and other construction workers in Bihar.

benefits.description: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- for the marriage of two adult daughters or for the female member's own marriage.

schemes.eligibility_description: The worker must be engaged in building or construction work, registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and have maintained continuous and active membership for at least three years. Both male and female registered workers can avail benefits for their two adult daughters' marriages, while female workers are also eligible for their own marriage. Workers who remarry are not eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Official Website of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
2. Click on "Scheme Application" and select "Apply for Scheme".
3. Enter your registration number and click "Show" to view your details.
4. Select the scheme, enter all required information, and upload necessary documents.
5. Click on "Submit Application" to complete the process.
6. Track your application status online through the official website.

documents_required.name: Photo of daughter with applicant or passport-size photo of applicant
Proof of marriage (photo, invitation card, certificate)
Bank account details/copy of bank passbook

schemes.ministry: Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana (SJY)
schemes.description: Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana (SJY), launched by the Government of Bihar, aims to empower approximately 100,000 ultra-poor households by providing sustainable livelihood opportunities. Implemented by JEEViKA, it uses the globally recognized Graduation Approach, offering asset transfers, capacity-building, livelihood gap assistance, and mentoring. The initiative ensures long-term self-reliance and access to insurance and public entitlements for beneficiaries.
objectives: To empower approximately 100,000 ultra-poor households in Bihar.
To provide sustainable livelihood opportunities through asset transfers, capacity building, and mentoring.
To ensure long-term self-reliance and access to social security and public entitlements for beneficiaries.

benefits.description: Livelihood Gap Assistance of ₹1,000/- per month for the initial seven months to support basic needs.
Productive Asset (micro-enterprise, livestock, agriculture) transfer of an average value of ₹60,000/-, with a limit of ₹1,00,000/-.
Insurance premiums covered for each beneficiary under Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) and Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMJSBY).
24 months of personalized guidance by Master Resource Persons (MRPs), capacity-building training, and life-skills coaching.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of Bihar, belong to an ultra-poor household identified through participatory processes, and be from socially or economically vulnerable groups like SC/ST communities. They should not have significant alternative livelihood sources.
schemes.application_process:
1. Eligible ultra-poor households are identified through a participatory process facilitated by Village Organizations (VOs).
2. Applicants need to provide the required documents to JEEViKA representatives.
3. The submitted documents and eligibility criteria are verified by program authorities.
4. Once approved, beneficiaries are enrolled in the program, assigned a Master Resource Person (MRP) for guidance, and receive other assistance.

documents_required.name: Proof of identity (Aadhaar card or equivalent)

schemes.ministry: Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Total Permanent Disability
schemes.description: The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana, launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, aims to provide social security to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector. This specific component offers financial assistance for total permanent disability. It targets individuals who suffer severe, permanent incapacitation due to accidents or specific medical conditions.
objectives: To provide social security to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.
To offer financial assistance for total permanent disability.
To support individuals who become permanently incapacitated due to accidents or specific medical conditions.

benefits.description: One-time financial assistance for total permanent disability.

eligibility.occupation: Worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector
eligibility.disability: Total permanent disability as defined by the scheme

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state and work as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 65 years, calculated as of the 1st of July of any year. Total permanent disability means that due to an accident, both eyes, both hands, or both legs become useless, or one eye, one hand, and one leg become useless. It also includes both eyes becoming useless due to paralysis or the brain stopping working.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the concerned office of the District Officer or Committee.
2. Collect the application form, fill it, and attach all mandatory documents.
3. Submit the complete application to the concerned District Officer or Labour Welfare Committee.

documents_required.name: Proof of age (e.g., Aadhar Card, Voter Card)
One photograph showing the disability status of the applicant
Copy of information given to the police station about the accident OR certificate issued by Mukhiya/Ward Councillor regarding the accident
Disability certificate issued by competent authority (Government orthopedic surgeon)
Certificate issued by Mukhiya/Ward Member/Ward Councillor specifying the nature of work
Bank Account and IFSC (Photocopy of the first page of the passbook)

schemes.ministry: Labour Resources Department, Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana, implemented by the Transport Department of the Bihar Government, aims to provide transportation facilities connecting blocks and remote Panchayats with district headquarters. This scheme enhances connectivity and mobility for residents across Bihar. It also encourages entrepreneurship among scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, extremely backward classes, backward classes, and minority communities by offering financial support for bus purchases.
objectives: To provide transportation facilities connecting blocks and remote Panchayats with district headquarters.
To enhance connectivity and facilitate mobility for residents across Bihar.
To encourage entrepreneurship among specified communities by providing financial support for bus purchases.

benefits.description: Subsidy for purchasing one bus

schemes.eligibility_description: Beneficiary must be a resident of the block where they apply, hold a valid driving license, and not be employed in government service.
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit the Transport Department’s official website for Mukhyamantri Block Transport Yojana registration. 2. Fill in required details including Phone Number, Password, Email ID, and Driving Licence Number. 3. Submit the registration details.
schemes.ministry: Transport Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana
schemes.description: The Chief Minister Rural Drinking Water Nishchay Yojana was launched in 2016 in Bihar to ensure every rural household has access to safe drinking water through a piped supply system. The scheme is implemented in phases by Gram Panchayats, covering areas where water quality is not compromised or not already handled by the Public Health Engineering Department. It aims to provide a maximum of 70 liters per person per day with strong community participation.
objectives: To ensure every rural household in Bihar has access to safe drinking water through a piped supply system.
To improve health and hygiene in rural areas by providing clean drinking water.
To reduce the incidence of waterborne diseases among rural populations.

benefits.description: Provides safe, clean, and purified drinking water to rural households.
Ensures better health and hygiene by reducing waterborne diseases.
Guarantees a continuous and uninterrupted supply of water throughout the year.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of a rural area in Bihar and must not already have a piped water supply connection. The household should require access to safe drinking water, comply with Gram Panchayat guidelines, and be willing to contribute to the operation and maintenance of the water supply system.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Gram Panchayat office.
2. Fill in the application form with required personal and household details.
3. Submit supporting documents such as identity and address proof.
4. The application will be reviewed for eligibility.
5. Upon approval, the household will be included in the piped water supply scheme.

documents_required.name: Identity proof (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, etc.)
Residential proof of the Gram Panchayat

schemes.scheme_name: Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana: Dress for Pre-school Children
schemes.description: The "Dress for Pre-school Children" scheme, a component of the "Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana" by Bihar's Social Welfare Department, provides ₹400 annually for uniforms. It targets children aged 3 to 6 years receiving pre-school education at Anganwadi Centres. The scheme aims to foster a distinct identity, uniformity, and social harmony among these children.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for uniforms to pre-school children.
To create a distinct identity for Anganwadi Centre children.
To bring a sense of uniformity and social harmony among children.

benefits.description: An annual cash amount of ₹400 per child is provided for uniforms to children aged 3 to 6 years enrolled in Anganwadi Centres.

schemes.eligibility_description: Beneficiary must be a child aged 3 to 6 years, a resident of Bihar, enrolled at an Anganwadi Centre, and receiving pre-school education there.
schemes.application_process: 1. Beneficiaries should register their names at their nearest Anganwadi Center.
schemes.ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar

schemes.scheme_name: National Food Security Mission NFSM
schemes.description: The National Food Security Mission (NFSM) aims to bridge the yield gap for various crops by disseminating improved technologies and farm management practices. It provides incentives like seed production and distribution, seed mini kits, demonstrations, improved farm implements, bio-pesticides, micronutrients, and bio-fertilizers to farmers. The mission targets enhancing crop production and productivity across selected districts in India.
objectives: Enhance production and productivity of crops.
Promote and extend improved technologies and seed varieties through various demonstrations.
Provide assistance for quality/certified seeds production and distribution.

benefits.description: Incentives for crop demonstrations: Rs 9000/- per ha for sole crop (excluding coarse cereals), Rs 15000/- per ha for cropping-system based demonstration, and Rs 6000/- per ha for coarse cereals.
Assistance for purchase and distribution of quality seeds for selected farmers, limited to 2 ha per crop season, with rates varying by crop.
Support for nutrient management, pest management, bio-pesticides, micronutrients, and bio-fertilizers.
Provision for farm implements/machines, capacity building of farmers, water carrying pipes, and post-harvest technologies like Dal Mill/de-stoning/grading.

schemes.eligibility_description: All farmers are eligible to apply for the scheme, with assistance limited to 5 hectares in a season. Special Component Plan (SCP) for Scheduled Castes and Tribal SubPlan (TSP) for Scheduled Tribes earmarks 16% and 8% of total allocation respectively, or proportionate to population. At least 33% of funds are allocated for small and marginal farmers, and 30% for women farmers. Districts are selected based on crop area and yield criteria for rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and nutri-cereals.
schemes.application_process: 1. Individual beneficiaries are identified in a transparent, time-bound manner, involving Gram Panchayats and Panchayati Raj Institutions. 2. Funds are released from the NFSM-EC to State governments. 3. State Governments release funds to State Level Agencies via PFMS/Treasury. 4. State Level Agencies make funds available to District Level Agencies. 5. District Level Agencies release funds to Implementing Agencies or beneficiaries.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

schemes.scheme_name: Term Loan Scheme of NMDFC
schemes.description: This scheme by NMDFC provides credit for economically viable income generation ventures to individuals from notified minority communities. It offers loans under two credit lines with varying amounts and interest rates, aiming to support self-employment. A concession is also extended to women beneficiaries under Credit Line-2.
objectives: To provide concessional credit for economically viable income generation ventures.
To promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among minority communities.
To financially empower individuals from notified minority communities.

benefits.description: Credit Line-1 loan up to Rs. 20 lakhs at 6% p.a. for income generation ventures.
Credit Line-2 loan up to Rs. 30 lakhs at 8% p.a. for income generation ventures, with a 2% concession for women beneficiaries.

eligibility.caste: Minority Communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain)

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian citizens from one of the six notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain), aged 18 or above, and capable of self-employment. Annual family income should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh for Credit Line-1 or Rs. 8.00 lakh for Credit Line-2. Applicants must not have outstanding loans from other government schemes and must have a viable project, Aadhaar-linked bank account, and relevant certificates. Insurance of borrower and assets is mandatory.
schemes.application_process:
1. Contact State Channelizing Agencies (SCA) or Banking Partners (Canara Bank, Punjab Grameen Bank).
2. Obtain and duly fill the prescribed loan application form.
3. Gather all required documents including proof of minority status, income, and project report.
4. Submit the completed application form along with all necessary documents to the SCA or Bank.

documents_required.name: Proof of Minority Status (Self-declaration or certificate)
Income Certificate issued by a competent authority
Residence Proof (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Ration Card, or Utility Bill)
Bank Account Proof (Cancelled cheque or first page of passbook, Aadhaar linked)
Affidavit/Self-declaration stating non-availment of loan from other government schemes

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Minority Affairs

schemes.scheme_name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme
schemes.description: The Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme (BIG) is a flagship initiative by BIRAC to support innovative ideas in the biotech sector. It provides funding and mentoring to individual entrepreneurs and start-ups. The scheme aims to translate promising ideas into commercially viable products and technologies.
objectives: Support ideation to Proof of Concept in biotechnology.
Nurture entrepreneurship to translate ideas into commercially viable products/technologies to address unmet needs.
Enable the Biotech Startup Ecosystem in India to become globally competitive.

benefits.description: Grant-in-aid of up to INR 50 lakhs (approx. USD 75,000) for a period of 18 months to support project execution.
Continuous mentoring support including technical, IP, legal, networking, training, regulatory advice, business mentoring, and investor connections.

schemes.eligibility_description: Individual applicants must be Indian citizens, project leaders, and incubated. If formally employed, a No Objection Certificate (NOC) or an undertaking to resign is required. Companies/LLPs must be registered under Indian law, incorporated within 5 years, and majority-owned by resident Indian citizens/companies. They must have an in-house R&D facility or be incubated. A technically qualified Project Leader, who is also a shareholder in the applicant company, is mandatory for all applications.
schemes.application_process:
1. BIRAC issues a national call for applications under BIG at least twice a year (January 1st & July 1st).
2. Applicants must submit their proposals online ONLY through the BIRAC website.
3. Register on the BIRAC website under the “BIG User” category.
4. Fill out and submit the application form by visiting the official website.

documents_required.name: Letter of Intent/Memorandum of Understanding with Incubator
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer (if applicable)
Original documents for eligibility verification during due diligence

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Science And Technology

schemes.scheme_name: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: The Khadi Vikas Yojana is an umbrella scheme under Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana, implemented by KVIC under the Ministry of MSME. It aims to support Khadi institutions and artisans by providing financial assistance, infrastructure development, and marketing support. The scheme offers subsidies, reduces interest burden on loans, facilitates workshed construction, and strengthens existing Khadi institutions.
objectives: To provide financial assistance and infrastructure development to Khadi institutions and artisans.
To reduce the interest burden on bank loans and facilitate the construction of worksheds for artisans.
To strengthen existing weak Khadi institutions and enhance marketing infrastructure, including sales outlets.

benefits.description: Provides a subsidy of 35% on prime cost for Cotton/Muslin, Wool, and Polyvastra Khadi, and 20% for Silk Khadi under Modified Market Development Assistance (MMDA).
Under the ISEC scheme, Khadi Institutions pay only 4% interest on bank loans, with KVIC bearing the difference as interest subsidy.
Offers financial assistance up to ₹1,20,000 for individual worksheds (75% of cost, 90% for NER) and up to ₹80,000 for group worksheds (75% of cost, 90% for NER).
Provides financial assistance up to ₹15 lakh for revival of weak Khadi institutions and up to ₹25 lakh for renovation of departmental sales outlets and marketing infrastructure.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a Khadi artisan or Khadi Institution registered with KVIC or KVIB. One person per family is eligible, and the applicant should not have availed benefits from any other government scheme for the same purpose. Preference is given to SC/ST, women, unemployed youth, and BPL category applicants.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the KVIC online portal and click on “Online Registration of Khadi Institutions.”
2. Fill in all required institutional details, including name, address, and infrastructure information, then save the form.
3. Receive a Username, Password, and Unique ID on your registered email and mobile, and download the acknowledgement.
4. Login using your credentials and upload all required documents such as registration certificate, list of artisans, and bylaws.
5. The KVIC office verifies the application and documents.
6. Once approved, the Certificate of Registration (CoR) is issued online for download.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card or other government-issued identity proof
Khadi artisan card or Khadi Institution registration certificate

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

schemes.scheme_name: "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme
schemes.description: This scheme, by the Ministry of Textiles, aims to develop and promote marketing channels for handloom products in domestic and export markets, enhancing visibility and ensuring fair remuneration for weavers. It provides a Marketing Incentive calculated at 10% on average sales of handloom products from the last 3 years. The assistance is shared between Central and State Governments, except for National Level Handloom Organizations where it is fully borne by the Central Government.
objectives: Develop and promote marketing channels in domestic and export markets in a holistic and integrated manner.
Bring greater visibility to the handloom sector.
Ensure commensurate remuneration to weavers.

benefits.description: Marketing Incentive calculated at 10% on average sales of handloom products over the last 3 years.
Maximum cap of ₹1,00,00,000/- for state level organizations (Central Government share).
Maximum cap of ₹15,00,000/- for primary societies (Central Government share).
10% of benefits shared equally between organizations and member weavers through Direct Benefit Transfer.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a handloom agency (State/National Level Organizations, Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies, Producer Companies, Self Help Groups, Joint Liability Groups, Federations, or other eligible entities). The applicant must have made the final transaction of product sale to the consumer, use Handloom Mark or India Handloom Brand, and have average sales turnover of handloom products for the last 3 years for incentive calculation.
schemes.application_process:
1. Compile sales bills, yarn purchase bills, and 3-year average sales turnover details, ensuring GST compliance.
2. Fill the prescribed proforma (Annexure - B8) and submit it to the concerned State Government with supporting documents.
3. State Government verifies claims, ensures matching contribution, and obtains State Level Project Committee recommendations.
4. State Government prepares a consolidated statement, sanction order for state share, and identifies a suitable nodal agency.
5. State Government forwards verified claims to the Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms).
6. The identified Nodal Agency releases funds to eligible handloom agencies and member weavers via Direct Benefit Transfer within 7 days.

documents_required.name: Sales Bills/invoices for Handloom Products (Goods and Services Tax Compliant)
Yarn Purchase Bills (Goods and Services Tax Compliant)
Average Sales Turnover Details of Handloom Products for the Last 3 Years
Handloom Mark or India Handloom Brand Usage Documentation
Final Transaction Proof of Product Sale to Consumer
Certificate as Per Prescribed Proforma (Annexure - B9) for Each Individual Claim
Sanction Order for Release of State Share

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Textiles

schemes.scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
schemes.description: The PRISM scheme, launched by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology, supports innovations in individuals, start-ups, and MSMEs. Category II specifically focuses on funding for fabrication of working models, process know-how, testing, patenting, and technology transfer. It aims to support projects with demonstrable original ideas and inventions, with project costs between ₹5,00,000 and ₹35,00,000.
objectives: To promote innovations in individuals, start-ups, and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).
To provide financial support for the fabrication of working models, process know-how, testing, trial, patenting, and technology transfer.
To encourage rigorous demonstrability of original ideas, inventions, or know-how in the form of working prototypes or processes.

benefits.description: Maximum support of ₹20,00,000 or 90% of the approved project cost, whichever is lower. Approved project cost must be between ₹5,00,000 and ₹35,00,000.

Support for R&D, design engineering, consultancy, rental charges, essential equipment, raw materials, fabrication, manpower (up to 20% of project cost), testing, travel (up to 5% of project cost), patent filing, and process know-how development.
Approved projects are monitored by TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres and Project Review Committees, with periodic status reporting and expert reviews.

eligibility.occupation: Innovators, Students, Individuals working in organizations

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be an Indian Citizen with an innovative idea or invention. The proposed project cost must be more than ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹35,00,000, with a duration not exceeding 24 months. The proposal must involve fabrication of a working model, process know-how, testing and trial, patenting, or technology transfer, and not solely software development or basic scientific research. Students require a 'No Objection Certificate' from their institution, and employed individuals need one from their employer.
schemes.application_process:
1. Innovators should consult with coordinators of TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs) and prepare the application form with all mandatory details.
2. Submit the application either directly to the nearest TOCIC or to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
3. Proposals undergo initial screening for completeness and evaluation by Domain Knowledge Experts at TOCICs.
4. Complete and evaluated proposals are forwarded to DSIR for consideration by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC).
5. Upon final approval by the Department, the applicant signs 'Terms & Conditions' prior to the actual release of grants-in-aid.
6. Funds are released in stages, with subsequent releases based on project progress assessment by the Project Review Committee (PRC).

documents_required.name: Documentary Proof Of Prior Work (Video, Photo, Press Coverage, etc.)
No Objection Certificate (from Head of Institute/Organization, for Students and Working Innovators)
Proposed Costs And Time Frame For The Project
Activity Details/Work Plan With Monitorable Milestones
Signed 'Terms & Conditions' Document (Required Prior To Grants-in-aid Release)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Science And Technology

schemes.scheme_name: Stand-Up India
schemes.description: The Stand-Up India scheme, launched by the Ministry of Finance, aims to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and women. It facilitates bank loans ranging from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield enterprises in various sectors. The scheme specifically targets new ventures in manufacturing, services, trading, and activities allied to agriculture.
objectives: To facilitate bank loans for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and/or Women Entrepreneurs.
To support the establishment of greenfield projects in manufacturing, services, trading, and allied agriculture sectors.
To ensure at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch receives a loan.

benefits.description: Facilitation of composite loan (inclusive of term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹100 Lakhs.
Issuance of a Rupay debit card for the convenience of the borrower.
Hand-holding support through a web portal by SIDBI, offering training, skill development, mentoring, project report preparation, and application filling assistance.

schemes.eligibility_description: Finance is provided for Greenfield Enterprises. If the applicant is a male, he must be from SC / ST category. The applicant must not be in default to any bank/financial institution. In case of non-individual enterprises, at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either an SC/ST or Woman entrepreneur.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official Stand-Up India portal: www.standupmitra.in.
2. Register by entering business location, category (SC, ST, Woman), and proposed business details.
3. Provide past business experience and personal details, including enterprise name and constitution.
4. Select if hand-holding support is required.
5. Complete registration to initiate the loan application process with the respective financial institution.

documents_required.name: Proof of Identity (Voter’s ID, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card)
Proof of Residence (Telephone/Electricity bill, Property tax receipt, Passport, Voter’s ID)
Proof of non-defaulting status to any bank/financial institution
Business Constitution Documents (e.g., Memorandum and Articles of Association, Partnership Deed)
Assets and liabilities statement of promoters and guarantors along with latest income tax returns
Business Premises Documents (Rent Agreement if on rent, Lease deeds/Title deeds of properties)
Category Proof (Documents to establish SC/ST/Woman category or majority stake holding)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Finance

schemes.scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
schemes.description: The Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes scheme, launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, aims to promote entrepreneurship among the Scheduled Caste population. It provides concessional finance for innovation and growth technologies, supporting projects in manufacturing, services, and allied sectors. Financial assistance ranges from ₹10,00,000 to ₹15,00,00,000, offered through debt/convertible instruments or equity investment.
objectives: To promote entrepreneurship among the Scheduled Caste population.
To provide concessional finance for innovation and growth technologies.
To support asset creation for projects/units in manufacturing, services, and allied sectors, including start-ups.

benefits.description: Financial assistance ranging from ₹10,00,000 (minimum) to ₹15,00,00,000 (maximum), provided through debt/convertible instruments or equity investment.
Interest/coupon rate of 4% per annum for debt/convertible instruments, reduced to 3.75% for Scheduled Caste women and disabled entrepreneurs.
Offers working capital gap funding (up to 20% of total assistance) and Technology Business Incubator (TBI) funding (up to ₹10,00,000 per year for 3 years) for innovative ideas.
The fund bears the fees for the Valuer and Lawyer for the first valuation and title search of properties.

schemes.eligibility_description: The scheme targets projects/units in manufacturing, services, and allied sectors, including start-ups and those incubated in technology business incubators, ensuring asset creation. Companies applying for assistance up to ₹50,00,000 must have at least 51% shareholding by Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs for the past 6 months, or be a successor entity meeting similar criteria. For assistance above ₹50,00,000, the 51% SC shareholding must be maintained for the past 12 months. Technology-oriented innovative projects, including those selected by TBIs or with patents/copyrights by first-time SC entrepreneurs, are also eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register online by creating an account and filling mandatory fields.
2. Log in using credentials and navigate to the scheme's online form.
3. Fill in all mandatory fields and upload required documents, then review and submit.
4. Proposals undergo screening by a committee on a first-come, first-served basis.
5. Detailed appraisal and due diligence, including site visits, are carried out by IFCI Venture Capital Funds Limited.
6. The Investment Committee reviews for final sanction, followed by Letter of Intent, legal documentation, valuation, and title search.

documents_required.name: Sanction letter of department of Government of India (if applicable)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship
schemes.description: The Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship recognizes, encourages, supports, and promotes translational research in engineering by Indian Nationals. It aims to transfer fundamental research output into viable technological products, devices, components, or processes. The scheme targets Indian nationals working in public funded institutions with a proven track record in innovation or technology development.
objectives: To recognize, encourage, support, and promote translational research in engineering by Indian Nationals.
To transfer fundamental research output into viable technological products, devices, components, or processes.
To achieve excellence in engineering, innovation, and technology development.

benefits.description: Monthly fellowship amount in addition to regular income.
Annual research grant for the fellow.
Annual overhead grant to the host institute.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian nationals or Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) working in permanent positions in publicly funded institutions in India. They should possess adequate professional qualifications, hold at least a bachelor’s degree with an outstanding track record in innovation or technology development, and have a minimum of five years of service left in their parent organization. Applicants must not be holding any other fellowship.
schemes.application_process:
1. Nominations are accepted throughout the year from Heads of Institutions/organizations, Presidents/fellows of National Science/Engineering Academies, SS Bhatnagar Awardees, and JC Bose awardees (self-nominations are not accepted).
2. Download the Nomination Form from the INAE website.
3. Submit the completed Nomination Form along with all supporting documents/appendices via email to INAE at inaehq@inae.in.
4. Selection will be made by a specially constituted Search-Cum-Selection Expert Committee.

documents_required.name: Proof that the candidate is working
Bank Details (Bank Account Number, Name of the Bank, Bank Branch, and IFSC Code)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Science And Technology

schemes.scheme_name: ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship
schemes.description: The ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship promotes original, socially relevant, and policy-focused research in social sciences. It provides financial support to full-time Ph.D. scholars through monthly grants and contingency funds for up to two years. The scheme aims to foster research excellence and evidence-based scholarship relevant to policymakers in India.
objectives: To promote original, socially relevant, and policy-focused research in the social sciences.
To provide financial support to full-time Ph.D. scholars pursuing research in social science disciplines.
To foster research excellence, evidence-based research, and scholarship relevant to policymakers in India.

benefits.description: Annual contingency grant for research-related expenses.
Standalone contingency grant for specific research needs or a six-month short-term fellowship for scholars nearing Ph.D. submission.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be an Indian citizen and a full-time bonafide Ph.D. scholar in a social science discipline at a UGC-recognized university or institution. The Ph.D. topic must be confirmed by the DRC/authorised statutory body. A minimum of 55% marks in post-graduation is required, with a 5% relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC-(NCL)/PwD). Age relaxation of 5 years is allowed for SC/ST/OBC-(NCL) candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD).
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit the ICSSR website (www.icssr.org) and navigate to the Fellowships section. 2. Click on the Doctoral Fellowship Scheme. 3. Register/Login to the ICSSR portal. 4. Fill the online application form. 5. Upload required documents and submit the application.

documents_required.name: Documents as specified in the Application Form when the Call is announced

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

schemes.scheme_name: Persons With Disabilities Scheme In Colleges: Higher Education For Persons With Special Needs
schemes.description: The Higher Education for Persons with Special Needs (HEPSN) scheme aims to create an inclusive environment in higher education institutions for differently-abled persons. It focuses on enriching their learning experiences by improving accessibility, providing special equipment, and fostering awareness. The scheme provides financial assistance to colleges to implement these facilities and support services.
objectives: To provide equal educational opportunities to differently-abled persons in higher education institutions.
To create awareness among higher education functionaries about the specific educational needs of differently-abled persons.
To equip higher education institutions with facilities and special devices to provide access and augment learning experiences for differently-abled persons.

benefits.description: Colleges receive an annual budgetary provision of ₹50,000 for general administration, stationery, contingencies, and organizing awareness programs and counseling sessions for differently-abled persons. An honorary coordinator receives ₹4000 per month.

A one-time grant of up to ₹5,00,000 per college is provided to address accessibility issues, including constructing ramps, rails, special toilets, and making other necessary environmental changes for mobility and independent functioning.

An ad hoc one-time grant of up to ₹1,50,000 per college is provided for procuring special learning and assessment devices such as computers with screen reading software, low-vision aids, scanners, and mobility devices, and for providing Readers for visually challenged students.

schemes.eligibility_description: Colleges applying for the grant must have enrolled disabled persons (including visual, hearing, and locomotor disabilities) in various courses. Institutions must be approved by the UGC under Sections 2(f) and 12 B. The college should have constituted an expert committee involving faculty members, experts, and differently-abled persons, meeting at least once a year to review scheme activities.
schemes.application_process:
1. Send application for specific projects in the prescribed Proforma for financial assistance.
2. Include the College Development proposal.
3. For Component 1, the initial grant is released after proposal approval; subsequent grants require an audited utilization certificate.
4. For Component 2, the grant is released upon receipt of detailed plans and estimates as per UGC building guidelines.
5. For Component 3, 90% of the grant is released as the first installment, with the remaining 10% on a reimbursement basis after submitting an audited statement of expenditure and utilization certificate.

documents_required.name: Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc)
Proof of the Latest Educational Qualification (Passing Certificate or Marksheet)
Any other document required by the College or the District Social Welfare Office

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
schemes.description: The National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship scheme, by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, provides opportunities for school and college students to familiarize themselves with or pursue research in various branches of earth sciences. NCESS is an R&D institution recognized for doctoral programs, hosting scientists and allowing students to present research projects. It aims to foster scientific interest and provide practical research experience.
objectives: To familiarize school and college students with different branches of earth sciences.
To provide opportunities for students to pursue research in earth sciences.
To offer training and dissertation opportunities at the National Centre for Earth Science Studies (NCESS).

benefits.description: A Certificate of Internship will be issued to interns upon successful completion of the program.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a student from a recognized University/Institute belonging to one of the following streams: 5 years Integrated M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech./M. Tech. (7th-9th Semester), 3 years M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech. (3rd-5th Semester), 2 years MSc. /M.Sc. Tech. / M. Tech. (2nd-3rd Semester), or B.Sc Final year students. Students must undergo at least 8 weeks of continuous training in NCESS.
schemes.application_process:
1. Interested candidates must apply online through the attached format.
2. Online application deadlines are 1st-29th February and 1st-30th September every year.
3. For enquiries, contact visitingstudents@ncess.gov.in or techcell@ncess.gov.in.
4. Selected candidates must bring a printout of their application forms, duly signed by the HOD with an official seal, at the time of arrival for training.

documents_required.name: Printout of application form, signed by HOD with official seal (for selected candidates)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Earth Sciences

schemes.scheme_name: Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)
schemes.description: This is an Education Loan Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. It provides interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs) for Masters, M.Phil. and PhD level courses.
objectives: To award interest subsidies to meritorious students belonging to the Other Backward Classes and Economically Backward Classes.
To provide them with better opportunities for higher education abroad.
To enhance their employability.

benefits.description: The Government of India bears the interest payable on education loans during the moratorium period (course period plus one year or six months after getting a job, whichever is earlier).
The maximum eligible loan component for interest subsidy claim is ₹20,00,000.

eligibility.caste: Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be students admitted to approved Masters, M.Phil, or PhD level courses abroad, having availed a loan from a scheduled bank under the Indian Banks Association (IBA) Education Loan Scheme. The total income of the applicant from all sources shall not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
schemes.application_process:
1. The interest subsidy is linked with the existing Educational Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA) for Master, M.Phil and PhD levels.
2. The Nodal Bank will lay down the detailed procedure for processing and sanctioning interest subsidies in consultation with the Ministry.
3. A Recommendatory Committee will examine and recommend applications for the award of interest subsidy on a quarterly basis.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
schemes.description: This scheme provides opportunities for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates to pursue postgraduate level studies in professional subjects. It aims to offer financial assistance to eligible students undertaking courses like Engineering & Technology, Management, and Pharmacy in recognized Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges. The scholarship supports students in their first year of a full-time postgraduate professional course.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to eligible candidates from SC/ST categories.
Enable Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates to pursue postgraduate professional courses.
Support 1000 SC/ST candidates annually in their higher education endeavors.

benefits.description: Monthly scholarship for ME/M.Tech courses.
Monthly scholarship for other professional postgraduate courses.
Scholarship awarded for the duration of the postgraduate course (two or three years).
No contingency allowance is payable to selected students from the selection year 2017-18.
