schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must belong to the SC/ST category, hold a Graduate degree in the relevant subject, and have secured admission to a regular full-time postgraduate professional course in a recognized Indian University/Institution/College. Only students pursuing the first year of their postgraduate course during the current academic year are eligible to apply.
schemes.application_process:
1. Candidates apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) after the annual advertisement is published by UGC.
2. Navigate to 'Applicant Corner', click 'New Registration', and fill in all mandatory details.
3. Register, verify the mobile number with an OTP, and then log in to complete the application form.
4. Submit the application successfully to generate an application ID and password for future reference.
5. The host institution where the candidate is studying is required to verify the online application.
6. After selection, the scholarship amount will be disbursed to awardees via DBT mode.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University students
schemes.description: This is a scholarship scheme by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, providing financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families. It aims to help students meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. Scholarships are awarded based on Class 12th Board Examination results, with up to 82,000 fresh scholarships annually for graduate, postgraduate, and professional courses.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families.
Help students meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
Support students pursuing Graduate/Postgraduate degrees and professional courses in colleges and universities.

benefits.description: Annual scholarship for graduation level (first three years of college/university courses).
Annual scholarship for post-graduation level.
Annual scholarship for 4th and 5th year of 5-year/integrated professional courses.
Scholarship disbursed directly into Aadhaar seeded bank accounts via DBT.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12th Board Examination, pursuing regular degree courses in recognized colleges/institutions. For renewal, students must achieve at least 50% marks in annual examinations and maintain 75% attendance. Aadhaar seeded bank accounts are required.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the National Scholarships Portal (NSP) One Time Registration page and click 'Apply for OTR'.
2. Register your active mobile number and complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
3. Download the NSP OTR App and Aadhaar FaceRD App, then complete face authentication to generate your OTR number.
4. Log in to NSP with your OTR number and password, then reset your password.
5. Fill in the application form on the Applicant's Dashboard, ensuring all compulsory fields are completed and documents are uploaded.
6. Click 'Final Submit' to apply.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

schemes.scheme_name: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research
schemes.description: This scheme is a prestigious initiative by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, to advance university research in line with industry requirements. It encourages young, talented scholars to undertake industry-relevant research by partnering with institutions of academic excellence. The scheme aims to leverage research with industry’s innovative capacity, leading to tangible economic outcomes like patents and new products.
objectives: To encourage and inspire promising young Indian Ph.D. researchers to pursue industry-relevant research in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, and medicine.
To build industry-academia partnerships for advancing R&D.
To boost research on industrially relevant subject areas.

benefits.description: Full-time PhD scholars receive double the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF)/Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) amount as a scholarship, with half funded by the government and half by a partner company.
Selected fellows receive national and international exposure, mentoring through industry and academic experts, and periodic mentorship sessions.
Up to 100 new fellowships are awarded annually for PhD research in reputed technology and research institutions in India.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be an Indian full-time PhD scholar in any recognized Indian university/institute/research laboratory. The PhD registration date should not be more than 14 months from the date of application submission. A valid industry partner is required to financially support and provide guidance for an innovative, industry-relevant research topic. The selected applicant must be willing to work with the supporting company and not draw any other fellowship.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register as a student on www.primeministerfellowshipscheme.in or www.serbficci-iirrada.in.
2. Prepare the application form according to guidelines and submit it online.
3. Download the Call for Proposal and Document Checklist.
4. Tie up with a company and get required undertakings signed by valid signatories.
5. Collect all documents and make digital copies.
6. Fill out the application form online and submit it.

documents_required.name: Profile of Partner Company with Logo
Undertaking from the Industry Partner in the Research Project

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Science And Technology

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme For The Students Belonging To Scheduled Tribe For Studies In India
schemes.description: This is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, providing financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students for pursuing higher education in India. It covers courses from Class XI up to Post Graduation. The scheme aims to enable ST students to undertake quality education by providing timely financial support.
objectives: To enable eligible Scheduled Tribe students to undertake quality education from Post Matric to Post Graduate level by providing them financial assistance.
To create an error free platform ensuring that the targeted beneficiaries receive scholarship on time.
To promote higher education among Scheduled Tribe communities across India.

benefits.description: Monthly stipend ranging from ₹230 to ₹1200 for day scholars and hostellers, depending on the course of study (e.g., professional, non-professional, vocational, or Class XI/XII).
An additional stipend of ₹800 per month for hosteller Divyangjan students and ₹600 per month for day scholar Divyangjan students.
Payment of compulsory fees charged by educational institutions, subject to the limit fixed by the concerned State.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian nationals belonging to Scheduled Tribes, permanently settled in the State/UT from which they apply. They must have passed Matriculation or a higher examination and be pursuing recognized post-matriculation/post-secondary courses in India. Employed students are eligible if they take leave without pay and study full-time. Students cannot hold any other scholarship/stipend concurrently under this scheme.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the prescribed application form (separate for fresh and renewal) from concerned States/UTs.
2. Complete the application form in all respects.
3. Attach all required documents, including a passport-size photograph (for fresh applications).
4. Submit the complete application to the Head of the Institution being attended or last attended.
5. The institution will forward the application to the officer specified by the respective State/Union Territory Government.

documents_required.name: Passport-size photograph with signature (for fresh scholarship)
Attested copies of certificates, diplomas, degrees of all examinations passed
Original Caste certificate signed by an authorized Revenue Officer (not below Tahsildar rank)
Income declaration by self-employed parents/guardians (affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper) or income certificate from employer for employed parents/guardians
Receipt in acknowledgment of scholarship in the previous year (for renewal applications)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Tribal Affairs

schemes.scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
schemes.description: The Research Grant for In-Service Faculty Members scheme, introduced by the University Grants Commission (UGC), aims to provide opportunities for regularly appointed faculty members of Universities, Institutes, and Colleges. It supports them in pursuing research in their specific areas of interest. The grant offers financial assistance and a defined tenure for research activities.
objectives: To provide opportunities to regularly appointed faculty members of Universities/Institutes/Colleges to pursue research in their area(s).
To support in-service faculty members in undertaking and completing their research projects.
To enhance the research capabilities and output within higher education institutions across India.

benefits.description: A grant of ₹ 10,00,000 is provided for research expenses, including minor equipment, consumables, contingencies, fieldwork, and travel. The grant is released in three installments over the tenure.
The research grant provides a tenure of 2 years for the faculty member to complete their research work.
A total of 200 slots are available for eligible faculty members, subject to change by the Commission.

eligibility.occupation: Regularly appointed faculty members in eligible Universities/Institutes/Colleges

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be regularly appointed faculty members in Universities (under Section 2(f) of UGC Act, 1956 with NAAC accreditation), Deemed to be Universities (under Section 3 of UGC Act 1956 with NAAC accreditation), Institutions fully funded by Central/State Governments empowered to award Degrees, or Institutions of National Importance. The applicant's age should not exceed 50 years, and they must have a minimum of 10 years of service left. Additionally, applicants must have successfully supervised 5 full-time Ph.D. candidates and completed at least 2 sponsored research projects.
schemes.application_process:
1. Read the scheme guidelines carefully on the UGC website (frg.ugc.ac.in).
2. Register as a 'New User' on the portal, providing details and uploading a scanned photograph and signature.
3. Log in with the received credentials and change the password for the first time.
4. Fill out the 'Eligibility Criteria' form and submit it.
5. Complete the 'Data Capturing Format' by providing PG and Ph.D. details.
6. Read the declaration, agree to the terms, and submit the final application.

documents_required.name: Scanned copy of passport-size photograph and signature
Auto-generated application form signed by HoD/Registrar
Proof of being a single girl child (affidavit on ₹100 stamp paper)

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

schemes.scheme_name: National Solar Science Fellowship Programme
schemes.description: The National Solar Science Fellowship Programme, launched in February 2011 by the Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, supports Indian scientists working in solar energy science, engineering, and technology. It focuses on science, technology, and product development in collaboration with prestigious institutions. The program aims to provide a platform for top-quality scientists and engineers to expand resources and address complex problems of solar energy utilization.
objectives: Provide a platform to top quality scientists and engineers in the area of solar energy research.
Use and expand the resources available at identified schools/institutions in the country and abroad.
Address the complex problems of solar energy utilization for various end uses including power generation.

benefits.description: Each selected Fellow receives an annual grant of up to ₹32.00 lakhs, comprising emolument, contingencies, and a research grant, released to the host institution.

eligibility.occupation: Scientists and engineers in solar energy sciences, engineering, and technology

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian or of Indian origin, possess a doctorate or equivalent in solar sciences/engineering with at least ten years of experience, and have an outstanding track record. M.Tech. or M.S. degree holders with good published work and lab/industry experience may also be considered as a special case. The program is open to scientists currently employed in government/public institutions or those not associated but eager to pursue beneficial research.
schemes.application_process:
1. Applications are invited through open advertisement from talented scientists. 
2. Applicants shall submit their applications in the prescribed Proforma (Annexure-II). 
3. An R&D proposal in identified thrust areas, emphasizing potential impact, must be attached with the application. 
4. A comprehensive proposal should be submitted by all candidates for consideration by the Fellowship Management Committee. 
5. The Fellowship Management Committee scrutinizes applications, including the research project, and selects up to ten Fellows based on guidelines.

documents_required.name: Details of any awards/recognition received in the subject area
Details of Scientific/technical papers published in the relevant subject area

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy

schemes.scheme_name: Free Education For Sports Medal Winners / Participants Of National/ International Events
schemes.description: This scheme, introduced by the University Grants Commission and Ministry of Education, provides free education to medal-winning sportspersons pursuing higher education. It aims to assist national medalists and international participants, ensuring their holistic development. The scheme motivates them to achieve excellence in both sports and academics.
objectives: To assist medal-winning sportspersons in pursuing higher education.
To motivate sportspersons to achieve excellence in sports.
To motivate sportspersons to achieve excellence in academics.

benefits.description: Covers tuition fees and other funds for various degrees (Bachelor's, PG, Diploma, M.Phil, Ph.D., MBA, professional courses). Actual costs are covered for top-tier achievements, while national level participants receive 75% of actual costs. Stipends are also provided for M.Phil (₹7500/₹5000 per month), Ph.D. (JRF scale/₹7500 per month), and MBA/professional courses (₹7500/₹5000 per month).
Actual costs for boarding and lodging in hostel facilities are covered.
Allowances for special courses undertaken abroad are provided as per Government of India’s norms.
An annual allowance for a sports kit is provided, ranging from ₹6000 to ₹15000, depending on the level of sports performance.

schemes.eligibility_description: The scholarship is provided to medal winners of National games and participants in recognized international sporting events (recognized by World University Service, International Olympic Committee, and Olympic Committee of Asia) who have taken admission to UGC-recognized Universities/Colleges/Institutions. Continuance of the scholarship in subsequent years depends on their subsequent sports performance.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download the prescribed application form.
2. Fill in the application form with accurate details.
3. Attach a certificate of participation or medal-winning as proof of eligibility, attested by the Registrar or Principal of your institution.
4. Verify the form and attached documents for completeness and accuracy.
5. Submit the completed application form and required documents to the designated authority.

documents_required.name: Certificate of participation/medal winner (attested by Registrar/Principal)

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

schemes.scheme_name: Study in India Programme
schemes.description: The Study in India Programme, launched by the Ministry of Education, aims to establish India as a global education hub. It provides international students with a centralized digital platform for admissions, access to quality institutions, and comprehensive support for higher education in India. The scheme facilitates end-to-end admission and visa processes for foreign nationals.
objectives: To position India as a global education destination.
To provide international students with a single centralized digital platform.
To offer access to quality institutions and end-to-end admission and visa support for pursuing higher education in India.

benefits.description: Single centralized digital platform for registration, course search, application submission, visa, and FRRO processes.
Admission to NAAC-accredited, NIRF-ranked, autonomous, and globally ranked institutions offering over 8,000 courses.
Tuition fee waivers ranging from 10% to 100%, subject to institute discretion (no direct scholarship from the programme).
Assistance with visa and immigration through Indian Embassies/High Commissions, and 24x7 student support via contact center, email, and social media.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be foreign nationals seeking admission in India, have completed the required qualifying education as per course norms, apply through the Study in India portal, possess a valid passport, and meet academic and language requirements of the chosen institution. Indian nationals are not eligible, and admissions outside the Study in India portal are not covered.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register on the Study in India portal for the current academic year by creating a user account.
2. Assess and plan your estimated expenditure, including tuition fees, accommodation, and living expenses.
3. Select your preferred course and institution, then submit the online application through the portal.
4. Check the portal for the allotted course and institution based on merit and preferences.
5. Complete admission formalities and begin preparations for travel and study in India.

documents_required.name: English Language Proficiency Certificate (If Required by Institution)
Offer Letter Issued Through Study in India Portal

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education

schemes.scheme_name: Sukhatme National Award in Statistics
schemes.description: The Sukhatme National Award in Statistics, implemented by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation, recognizes outstanding contributions in high-quality research to improve official statistics. It aims to develop innovative methods for addressing challenges encountered in sample surveys, data management systems, and data integration. The scheme provides national-level recognition to eligible Indian statisticians for lifetime contribution or young achiever excellence.
objectives: To recognise outstanding contributions made by individuals in terms of high-quality research work.
To improve the system of official statistics in general.
To develop innovative methods for addressing challenges encountered in sample surveys, data management systems, and data integration.

benefits.description: National-level recognition for outstanding contributions in the field of statistics.
A citation signed by the Hon’ble Minister of Statistics & Programme Implementation, a shawl, and a memento.
Opportunity to receive the award on Statistics Day (29th June) and potentially highlight the significance of their work.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be an Indian National, at least 45 years of age as on 31st December of the financial year in which the award is announced. The applicant and their family members should not be involved in the selection process of the awardees.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official Rashtriya Puraskar (National Awards) Portal at https://www.awards.gov.in.
2. Select "Sukhatme National Award in Statistics" from the award list and click "Nominate / Apply Now".
3. On the new page, select "Click here to Register" under the Login to Portal section and choose registration type (Individual or Organisation).
4. Enter required personal details (Name, Date of Birth, Nominator/Applicant Type, Mobile Number, Email ID, Address, Gender, Aadhaar Number, CAPTCHA) and click Submit.
5. Submit the nomination or application along with testimonials from 3 distinguished statisticians or referees through the portal.
6. Applications are invited only through the National Awards Portal; applications submitted through any other mode are not considered.

documents_required.name: Testimonials From 3 Distinguished Statisticians or Referees
Detailed description of the nominee's contribution
Supporting documents (e.g., research papers, patents, awards certificates, letters of recommendation)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Statistics and Programme Implementation

schemes.scheme_name: Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence
schemes.description: The Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE) scheme facilitates faculty members from State Universities/Colleges and private Academic Institutions to conduct research in established public-funded central institutions. It aims to promote research excellence by providing financial support and access to advanced research facilities. The scheme covers various scientific and engineering disciplines, allowing PIs to work in both host and parent institutions.
objectives: To facilitate the mobility of faculty members working in State Universities/Colleges and private Academic Institutions to carry out research work in established public-funded central institutions.
To ensure that the Principal Investigator (PI) continues to work in both the host institute and their parent institute on mutually agreed terms.
To cover research areas under Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, and Mathematical Sciences, including interdisciplinary areas.

benefits.description: Annual research fellowship of ₹60,000/- (in addition to salary) for a minimum of 90 days of research work per year in the host institution.
Annual research grant of ₹5 lakhs (50% each to host and parent institution).
Overheads provided as per Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) norms.
Access to established public-funded central institutions for research work.

eligibility.occupation: Regular academic/research position in State Universities/ Colleges and private Academic Institutions

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian citizens residing in India, holding a Ph.D. degree in Science/Engineering or MS/MD in Medicine. They must hold a regular academic/research position in State Universities/Colleges or private Academic Institutions and should not have any ongoing research projects or fellowships at the time of application. The upper age limit is 45 years, with a 5-year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates. The mentor should be at the level of Associate Professor/Scientist E or higher.
schemes.application_process:
1. The call for proposals will be notified through the websites www.serbonline.in and www.serb.gov.in.
2. Applicant(s) should first register on the online website.
3. After login, fill all mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section, including Bio-data, Photo, and Institute Address.
4. Enter the summary of the project proposal, including Project Title, Abstract, Keywords, Objectives, and Expected output/outcome.
5. Upload other relevant proposal information as a single PDF file (not more than 10 MB) as other technical documents.
6. Proposals will be evaluated through peer review processes as per SERB guidelines.

documents_required.name: Other technical details of the proposal
Endorsement certificate from the Head of Parent Institution
Endorsement Letter from the Head of the Host Institution

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Science And Technology

schemes.scheme_name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Full Time PhD Candidates
schemes.description: This is an institutional scheme implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. It aims to enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors. The scheme provides financial support to full-time PhD candidates enrolled in allocated seats at eligible institutions.
objectives: To enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors in the country.
Give thrust to R&D, create an innovative ecosystem and enhance India’s competitiveness in these knowledge intensive sectors.
Support 1000 Full Time PhD seats in the areas of ESDM & IT/ITES.

benefits.description: ₹38,750/- per month in 1st & 2nd year and ₹43,750/- per month in 3rd, 4th and 5th years of PhD (support till PhD completion or 5 years whichever is earlier).
24%, 16% & 8% of fellowship for X, Y & Z class cities/towns respectively.
₹1,20,000/Year per Full Time PhD candidate for support duration.

Support to attend selected International Conferences up to ₹1.5 Lakh. One-time support for selected 250 Full Time PhD candidates for 6 months 'Visit to Labs Abroad' with ₹1.50 Lakh monthly fellowship and up to ₹1.50 Lakh for travel/visa expenses.

schemes.eligibility_description: This institutional scheme supports new PhD scholars enrolled in allocated seats during the scheme period. Candidates must not be receiving financial support for PhD from any other government scheme.
schemes.application_process: 1. Eligible institutions submit proposals for Full-time PhD seats against an active call by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY, via https://phd.dic.gov.in/. 2. Suitable number of seats are allotted to institutions based on their proposals. 3. Institutions conduct their admission process for enrolling PhD candidates on these allocated seats. 4. Interested candidates must contact their respective institutions for admission formalities and to apply for financial support under the scheme.

documents_required.name: Proposal for Full-time PhD seats (submitted by eligible institutions)
Documents as required by respective institutions for PhD admission and financial support application

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemes.scheme_name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Part Time PhD Candidates
schemes.description: This scheme is a component of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT, implemented by the Digital India Corporation under MeitY. It aims to generate 150 Part-time PhDs over five years in emerging research areas of ESDM and IT/ITES sectors. The scheme targets professionals working at reputed organizations, with seats allotted to institutions based on proposals and research strength.
objectives: To enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors in the country.
To give thrust to R&D, create an innovative ecosystem, and enhance India’s competitiveness in these knowledge-intensive sectors.
To generate a total of 150 Part-time PhDs in emerging research areas of ESDM and IT/ITES sectors over a period of 5 years.

benefits.description: Part-time PhD candidates will receive a one-time incentive upon successful completion of their PhD degree and reporting it through their institution.

schemes.eligibility_description: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme where eligible institutions submit proposals for Part-time PhD seats. These seats are for professionals working at reputed places/organizations. Selected candidates must not be availing any PhD Fellowship/scholarship from any other Central or State Government scheme.
application_process: The PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY notifies calls for proposals for Part-time PhD seats through its web portal (https://phd.dic.gov.in/).
Eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Part-time PhD seats.
Suitable numbers of seats are allotted to institutions based on assessment.
Interested candidates contact their respective allotted institutions for admission formalities.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemes.scheme_name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships
schemes.description: The Young Faculty Research Fellowship (YFRF) is a component of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT, implemented by the Digital India Corporation. It aims to promote R&D and enhance India’s competitiveness in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). This fellowship targets young faculty with a regular position at their institution and a proven research track record.
objectives: Promote R&D
Create an innovative ecosystem
Enhance India’s competitiveness in the knowledge-intensive sectors of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES)

benefits.description: Monthly research fellowship in addition to regular salary.
Annual research contingency grant for minor equipment, consumables, and domestic travel, for a maximum of 5 years.
Fellowship is for a maximum period of 5 years, initially for 2 years and extendable based on performance review.
Host institution provides necessary administrative and infrastructural support.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must hold a PhD degree from a recognized University with first class in all preceding levels and a good academic record. Must have a regular position in an eligible institution and be engaged in research. Cannot be availing any other fellowship from Government or Non-Government sources. YFRF can be availed only once in a career. Proposals must be submitted through eligible institutions.
schemes.application_process:
1. PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY periodically invites nominations from eligible institutions for the YFRF award.
2. Eligible institutions submit nominations (up to three per round) through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/.
3. Proposals should define clear objectives, outcomes, and deliverables.
4. Nominations are scrutinized and evaluated by experts.
5. Fellowships are awarded based on evaluation.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

schemes.scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen and their widows, up to the rank of Havildar/equivalent, to cover routine medical expenses. It aims to alleviate the financial burden of healthcare costs, especially for those without other income sources and facing poverty in old age. The scheme helps beneficiaries combat diseases and maintain their dignity by supporting their medical needs.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for routine medical expenses to non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen and their widows.
To support Ex-Servicemen and widows of ranks up to Havildar/equivalent who lack other sources of income.
To prevent eligible beneficiaries from falling into poverty due to increasing healthcare costs, especially in old age.

benefits.description: Financial assistance up to Rs. 30,000 per year is provided to eligible Ex-Servicemen or their widows for routine medical expenses.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen or their widow, of rank Havildar/equivalent and below. They must be recommended by their respective Zila Sainik Board, and expenditure must be incurred at recognized government hospitals at rates approved under CGHS/ECHS.
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit the official Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat website (ksb.gov.in) and register. 2. Fill the registration form with necessary details, upload photo, and save. 3. Activate the account via the link sent to the registered email and log in. 4. Select the scheme, fill the application form, and upload attested copies of supporting documents. 5. ZSWO will scrutinize the application, verify details, and forward it to KSB through RSBs. 6. KSB Secretariat processes the application, obtains approval, and the Accounts Section processes direct payment to beneficiaries via ECS.

documents_required.name: I-Card issued by ZSB (for ESM & widows)
Original medical bills countersigned by attending doctor
Hospital discharge summary countersigned by attending doctor
Certificate stating no money/grant taken from State or present employer
Bank A/c No (PNB/SBI only) and IFS Code

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Defence

schemes.scheme_name: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan
schemes.description: The "Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan" scheme, launched by the Kendriya Sainik Board under the Ministry of Defence, provides relief to war bereaved, war disabled, and attributable peacetime casualties. It offers reimbursement of 50% of the interest on a home loan, up to a loan amount of ₹1,00,000, for a maximum duration of five years. This scheme aims to support eligible ex-servicemen and their families in managing their home loan expenses.
objectives: To provide financial relief to war bereaved, war disabled, and attributable peacetime casualties.
To subsidize a portion of the interest paid on home loans for eligible beneficiaries.
To support ex-servicemen and their families in securing housing by easing their financial burden.

benefits.description: Reimbursement of 50% of the interest charged on a home loan, applicable on a loan amount up to ₹1,00,000.
The subsidy is provided for a maximum of 5 years or until the loan repayment is completed, whichever is earlier.

Applicable for home loans taken from banks, Government/Public Sector undertakings, Life Insurance Corporation (LIC), General Insurance Corporation (GIC), and Housing and Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO).

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a war widow, war bereaved family member, war disabled personnel, or attributable peacetime casualty (all ranks). The applicant must have taken a home loan from a bank, government/public sector undertaking, LIC, GIC, or HUDCO. The loan amount considered for subsidy must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register online at the Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat by providing personal, Aadhaar, email, mobile, and bank details, and setting a password.
2. Log in with the generated User ID and password, then select "New Application" and the scheme name.
3. Fill out the complete application form and upload required documents like photograph, caste certificate, residential certificate, and bank passbook.
4. Click "Save & Forward" and print the application form.
5. Submit the printed application along with all required documents to the District Sainik Board.
6. KSB Secretariat vets and approves the application, with final payment made online based on fund availability.

documents_required.name: Certificate from banker (no change in repayment schedule)
Statement from banker (amount of interest actually paid)
Certificate from banker (regular repayment of loan and interest)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Defence

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is an accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover. It targets individual bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years. The scheme provides financial protection against unforeseen accidents.
objectives: To provide affordable accident insurance cover to all eligible bank account holders.
To offer financial security to the nominee in case of the subscriber's accidental death.
To provide financial assistance to subscribers suffering from total or partial permanent disability due to an accident.

benefits.description: Nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs upon the subscriber's accidental death.
Subscriber receives Rs. 2 Lakhs for total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes, or loss of use of both hands or feet, or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot.
Subscriber receives Rs. 1 Lakh for total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot.

schemes.eligibility_description: Individual bank account holders of participating banks aged between 18 years (completed) and 70 years (age nearer birthday) who give their consent to join and enable auto-debit.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit a participating bank branch or download the application form from jansuraksha.gov.in.
2. Fill in all details on the form and submit it to the bank along with any required documents.
3. Upon successful submission, the subscriber will receive an Acknowledgement Slip Cum Certificate of Insurance.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Finance

schemes.scheme_name: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Internship Scheme
schemes.description: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Internship Scheme, initiated in 2016, engages Indian Nationals who are Graduates, Post Graduates, or Research Students from reputed institutions. Interns are attached to the Commission to assist with analysis, empirical data collection, and policy formulation. This scheme offers exposure to the Commission's functioning and vigilance issues, aiding interns in their career goals.
objectives: To allow young academic talent to be associated with the Commission’s work for mutual benefit.

To provide interns with exposure to the Commission’s functioning and vigilance issues, enabling them to contribute to policy formulation through empirical analysis, briefing reports, and policy papers.
To benefit the Commission by gaining additional resources in the form of young talent and their output, enhancing its policy formulation base.

benefits.description: Interns may receive a stipend of ₹10,000 per month to cover conveyance and daily needs.
The Commission provides working space, internet facility, and other necessities as deemed fit by Branch heads.
A certificate will be awarded upon satisfactory completion of the internship and submission of an end-of-assignment report.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian citizens, currently Graduates (awaiting final year results), Post Graduates, or Research Students enrolled in reputed Universities/Institutions in India or abroad, preferably studying Law, IT, MBA, Social Sciences, or associated subjects.
schemes.application_process:
1. Interested candidates should prepare their application as per the enclosed performa.
2. Submit the application in soft copy.
3. Send the application via email to nitin.72@gov.in.

documents_required.name: Letter of NOC from the Present Institution

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions

schemes.scheme_name: Indirect Tax Internship Scheme In Central Board Of Indirect Taxes And Customs (CBIC)
schemes.description: The Indirect Tax Internship Scheme by CBIC offers full-time, physical internships in Delhi for 10 law students and 10 law graduates annually. Interns assist in legal research, drafting petitions, and briefing counsels within CBIC's legal establishment. This scheme aims to provide practical experience in indirect taxation and legal assistance.
objectives: Provide practical legal experience to law students and graduates in the field of indirect taxation.
Assist CBIC officers and counsels with legal research, drafting, and case file study.
Deploy interns in different sections of CBIC's legal establishment to gain exposure.

benefits.description: Monthly stipend for law student interns.
Monthly stipend for law graduate interns.
Certificate of Internship upon satisfactory completion of minimum duration.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be law students pursuing a 3-year or 5-year integrated LLB course, or law graduates who completed their LLB not more than two years ago. Students who have appeared in their final year/semester exams by the cutoff date are also eligible.
schemes.application_process: 1. Prepare the duly filled and self-attested application in the prescribed format. 2. Gather all required documents. 3. Send the application and documents by email to dlasmc-cbic@gov.in.

documents_required.name: Proof of Educational Qualification (i.e. result sheet/mark sheet/provisional degree etc.)
Proof of having passed the LLB course (required at the time of joining for final year/semester students)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Finance

schemes.scheme_name: Summer Internship Scheme Of DGFT
schemes.description: The Summer Internship Scheme by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) facilitates interaction between its officers and young scholars/researchers from reputed academic institutions. It aims to refresh ideas from academia to critically analyze DGFT's activities and provide interns with an excellent opportunity for career advancement. The scheme familiarizes interns with the overall process of foreign trade policy formulation and implementation.
objectives: To facilitate interaction between DGFT officers and young scholars/researchers with brilliant academic backgrounds.
To enable DGFT to critically analyze its activities and take corrective steps in an objective and impartial manner.
To familiarize interns with the overall process of formulation of foreign trade policy at the macro level and its implementation at the micro level.

benefits.description: Interns will receive a consolidated token remuneration of ₹10,000/- per month.
Necessary logistics support will be provided to the intern based on functional requirements.
Certificates will be issued to interns upon satisfactory completion of their internship.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian nationals pursuing studies from India or abroad, with an excellent academic record. They should possess a graduation degree in Public Policy/Economics/Finance/Management/Law with at least 60% marks from National Schools of Law, Central Universities, AICTE recognized Financial/Economics Institutions, Recognized National Management Institutes, Foreign Universities, or Institutions of excellence.
schemes.application_process: 1. Email scanned applications in the prescribed proforma along with CVs to internship-dgft@gov.in.

documents_required.name: Permission Letter from Supervisor / Head of Department

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

schemes.scheme_name: Internship Scheme Of The Ministry Of Labour & Employment
schemes.description: This scheme engages eligible students as interns with the Ministry of Labour & Employment, offering them an opportunity to understand government functioning and policy issues. Interns contribute to policy and legislation formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysis and briefing reports. The program aims to provide mutual benefit to both the Ministry and the participating students.
objectives: Engage eligible students as interns to work for mutual benefit within the Ministry.
Provide interns an opportunity to understand Government functioning and Department Policy issues in India.
Enable interns to contribute to Policy/Legislation formulation by generating policy inputs.

benefits.description: A monthly stipend of ₹ 8,000/- is provided to interns for the duration of the internship.
Interns are provided with working space, a computer with internet facility, and other necessary logistic support.
A Certificate of Internship is issued upon satisfactory completion of the internship and submission of a report/paper.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be pursuing law (in the last two years of degree course), be Law Graduates, or students pursuing Post Graduation in Law or Research Scholars in Law. Students pursuing MBA / MSW / MSc / MA enrolled in a recognized University/Institution within India or abroad are also eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the prescribed application proforma.
2. Fill in the application form completely and self-attest it.
3. Send the duly filled and self-attested application form by email to adm1@nic.in.
4. Ensure the application is submitted by January 31st or July 31st of the respective year.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment

schemes.scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
schemes.description: The Ministry of External Affairs launched its Internship Programme in 2022 to bring foreign policy closer to the people and enhance focus on MEA. It aims to provide valuable experience to interns while ensuring gender inclusivity and diversity in qualifications, domicile, and socio-economic status. The program targets Indian citizens who are graduates or in their final year of graduation.
objectives: To take foreign policy closer to the people.
To bring more focus on the Ministry of External Affairs and provide value to interns.
To ensure better gender inclusivity and increase diversity in terms of qualifications, domicile, and socio-economic status in the cohort of interns.

benefits.description: An honorarium of ₹ 10,000 per month will be paid to each intern to defray basic costs.
Cost of one-time to and fro air travel between the State capital and Delhi, subject to a ceiling of prevailing economy class airfare.
Introduction to various aspects of MEA functioning, its public interface, and a possible visit to a Mission abroad.
Interns will be assigned specific topics for research, report writing, analysis, or other tasks by the Head of Division.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian citizens with a minimum educational qualification of a graduate degree from a recognized university, or be in the final year of graduation where an internship is mandatory. The candidate's age should not exceed 25 years as on 31 December of the internship year. Priority is given to candidates from TADP districts and those belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories.
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit https://internship.mea.gov.in/registration and register by providing your full name, gender, email ID, and password. 2. Verify your email ID by clicking the activation link received from egov.egit@mea.gov.in. 3. Visit https://internship.mea.gov.in/dashboard and click 'Apply for Internship'. 4. Fill in the application form with personal, educational, and internship details, and upload mandatory documents. 5. Preview your application and click 'Submit'.

documents_required.name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Head of Institution/Department/Principal

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of External Affairs

schemes.scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
schemes.description: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR) offers a short-term internship program (maximum 3 months) under the Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) scheme. It targets undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate students, and young research scholars (Doctoral/Post-doctoral) from recognized universities in India or abroad. Interns will work in various MoPR divisions, focusing on policy and action research related to local self-governments and rural development.
objectives: To engage students and research scholars to utilize their academic talents, knowledge, skills, and techniques for MoPR's Policy and Action Research work.
To provide interns with an opportunity to gain in-hand experience on local self-governments, government functioning, policies, and rural development initiatives.
To enable interns to provide relevant inputs, suggestions, and recommendations through data analysis, research, and policy analysis for preparing Policy Briefs and Working Papers.

benefits.description: Monthly stipend of Rs. 7,000.
Working space, internet facility, and library access for assignments.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be students enrolled/pursuing Undergraduate/Graduate/Postgraduate degrees or Research Scholars enrolled/pursuing Doctoral (Ph.D.)/Post-Doctoral degrees from recognized universities/institutions, or have completed any of these courses within the last 2 years, from India or Abroad. Preferred academic disciplines include Public Policy, Development Studies, Economics, Governance, Rural Development, Business Administration, Environment, Public Health, Sociology, Political Science, Social Work, Statistics, Data Analysis, and other relevant Social Sciences, Management, and Engineering streams. The internship duration is at least 15 days but not exceeding six (6) months. Interns must have their own laptop.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register on the ServicePlus website if not already registered.
2. Visit the Ministry's website, go to the "RGSA" section, and click "MoPR Internship".
3. Log in with your details on the new webpage.
4. Click on the "Apply Service" tab to open the online application form.
5. Fill in all details, choose "Area of Interest", upload photograph, and submit the form.

documents_required.name: Letter from Principal/Head of Department/Supervisor indicating student status
No Objection Certificate (NOC) for the internship period

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Panchayati Raj

schemes.scheme_name: NITI Internship Scheme
schemes.description: The NITI Internship Scheme engages undergraduate, graduate, and research scholars as interns at NITI Aayog. It provides exposure to various divisions within NITI Aayog, allowing interns to supplement analysis through empirical data collection and collation. The scheme aims to familiarize selected candidates with government functioning and developmental policy issues.
objectives: To allow young academic talent to be associated with the NITI Aayog's work for mutual benefit.
To provide interns an opportunity to understand Government functioning and Developmental Policy issues in India.
To enable interns to contribute to Policy formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysis, briefing reports, and policy papers.

benefits.description: An Experience Certificate/Internship Completion Certificate will be issued upon successful completion of the internship.
Allows young academic talent to be associated with NITI Aayog's work, fostering mutual benefit and professional growth.
Opportunity to gain knowledge about Government functioning and Developmental Policy issues in India.
Chance to contribute to policy formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysis, briefing reports, and policy papers.

schemes.eligibility_description: Bonafide students of any recognized University/Institution within India or abroad are eligible. Under-graduate students must have completed/appeared in the term end exams of second year/4th semester of their bachelor degree and secured not less than 85% in 12th class. Graduate students must have completed/appeared in the term end exams of first year/2nd semester of their post graduate programme or pursuing research/PhD and secured not less than 70% in Graduation. Students who have appeared in final exams or just completed Graduation/PG and are waiting for higher studies admission may also apply, provided they secured 70% or more cumulative marks and the period between result declaration and desired internship month does not exceed six months.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website: https://workforindia.niti.gov.in/intern/InternshipEntry/PCInternshipEntry.aspx.
2. Read the instructions and fill in all applicant details.
3. Choose only one area of interest in the designated field.
4. Click 'Preview' to verify all entered details; use 'Edit' for corrections.
5. Click 'Submit' for final submission once all details are correct.
6. Note down the Registration Number for future reference.

documents_required.name: Marksheets of all semesters/years of graduation, PG, along with the degree (as applicable)
No Objection Certificate (NOC) in a specific format

schemes.ministry: NITI Aayog

schemes.scheme_name: National Pension Scheme For Traders And Self Employed Persons
schemes.description: This is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, designed for old age protection and social security of Small Scale Traders and Retailers. Beneficiaries receive a minimum assured pension of ₹3000 per month after attaining 60 years of age. The scheme also includes provisions for family pension and benefits on disablement or exit.
objectives: To provide old age protection and social security for small scale traders and retailers.
To ensure a minimum assured pension of ₹3000 per month after attaining 60 years of age.
To support and recognize the contribution of workers in the unorganized sector.

benefits.description: Beneficiary receives a minimum assured pension of ₹3000 per month after attaining 60 years of age.
Upon the beneficiary's death, the spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension as a family pension.
If permanently disabled before 60, the spouse can continue the scheme or exit by receiving contributions with interest.
Beneficiary or spouse can exit the scheme and receive their contributions back with accumulated interest, depending on the duration of participation.

eligibility.occupation: Self-employed shop owners, retail traders, rice mill owners, oil mill owners, workshop owners, commission agents, real estate brokers, small hotel/restaurant owners, and other similar Vyaparis.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant should not be covered under any National Pension Scheme contributed by the Central Government or be a member of EPFO/NPS/ESIC. They must not be an income taxpayer or enrolled under Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana or Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the nearest CSC center.
2. Provide Aadhaar Card and bank account details.
3. Make an initial cash contribution to the Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE).
4. The VLE completes online registration by filling in personal, business, and nominee details.
5. Self-certify eligibility, pay the first subscription amount, and sign the auto-debit mandate form.
6. Receive a unique Vyapari Pension Account Number (VPAN) and a printed Vyapari Card.

documents_required.name: Bank Passbook (as evidence of bank account)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Labour and Employment

schemes.scheme_name: The NSFDC Internship Scheme
schemes.description: The NSFDC Internship Scheme 2024, implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, offers students practical experience within a Central Public Sector Enterprise. It aims to expose interns to socio-economic development schemes for scheduled caste communities. The program provides hands-on experience in a professional government environment.
objectives: To provide students with practical experience and understanding of a Central Public Sector Enterprise's operations.
To expose interns to various socio-economic development programs and schemes undertaken by NSFDC.
To enable students to develop skills in research, project management, and policy implementation within a professional setting.

benefits.description: Interns work on socio-economic development schemes, enhancing their understanding of social justice initiatives.
The internship allows students to develop skills in research, project management, and policy implementation.
Interns receive a certificate of experience upon successful completion, valuable for future career opportunities.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be pursuing or have completed undergraduate, graduate, or postgraduate degrees from recognized universities, colleges, or institutions in India. They must possess their own laptop and can avail the internship only once per financial year.
schemes.application_process: 1. Prepare a detailed resume along with academic documents and a No Objection Certificate (NOC). 2. Email the application to hr.nsfdc@gmail.com or hrd-nsfde@nic.in. 3. Mention 'NSFDC Internship Programme' in the subject of the email. 4. Apply online at least one month before the desired internship period.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Short Term Training
schemes.description: This scheme provides short-term skill training to Indian nationals who are school/college dropouts or unemployed, aiming to enhance their employability. It imparts training aligned with the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF), including soft skills, entrepreneurship, financial, and digital literacy. Upon successful completion, candidates receive placement assistance and support for international employment.
objectives: To benefit Indian nationals who are school/college dropouts or unemployed with relevant skill training.
To impart training according to NSQF, including soft skills, entrepreneurship, financial, and digital literacy.
To provide placement assistance and enhance potential for international employment through add-on bridge and language courses.

benefits.description: Training according to NSQF, including soft skills, entrepreneurship, financial, digital literacy, English, Employability & Entrepreneurship (EEE) modules, and add-on Bridge/language courses. Certification is provided upon successful assessment.

One-time incentive for certified candidates, boarding/lodging, conveyance, post-placement stipend, one-time placement travel cost, accidental insurance, and special incentives for foreign placements. Placement assistance is provided by training providers.

Online information/counselling platform, counselling helpline, district-level skill information centers, induction kit, participant handbook, and career progression support. Additional support is provided to PwD candidates.

Provision for both fresh skilling and reskilling for existing workforce. The scheme is compatible with international standards through add-on bridge and language courses to enhance global employment potential.

schemes.eligibility_description: This scheme is applicable to any candidate of Indian nationality who is aged between 15-45 years, possesses an Aadhaar card and an Aadhaar linked bank account, and fulfills other criteria for the respective job role as defined by the awarding body.
schemes.application_process: 1. Interested candidates can contact the nearest Training Center to apply.

documents_required.name: Documents as required for the job role

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship

schemes.scheme_name: Skill Loan Scheme
schemes.description: The Skill Loan Scheme, launched in July 2015, provides institutional credit to individuals for skill development courses. These courses must be aligned to National Occupations Standards and Qualification Packs, leading to a certificate/diploma/degree. It targets students admitted to ITIs, Polytechnics, recognized schools/colleges, or training partners affiliated with NSDC/Sector Skill Councils.
objectives: To provide institutional credit for skill development courses aligned with NSQF.
To enable individuals to pursue certificate, diploma, or degree programs in vocational training.
To facilitate access to finance for skill development without requiring collateral from beneficiaries.

benefits.description: Loan amount ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹1,50,000 to cover course fees and other completion expenses like assessment, examination, and study material.
Repayment period of 3 to 7 years based on loan amount, with a moratorium period equal to the course duration.
The scheme does not require any collateral to be charged from the beneficiary.
Loans are covered by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Skill Development (CGFSSD) for up to 75% of the outstanding amount against defaults.

schemes.eligibility_description: Any individual who has secured admission in a course run by Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), Polytechnics, schools recognized by Central or State education Boards, colleges affiliated to a recognized university, or training partners affiliated to National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) / Sector Skill Councils, State Skill Mission, State Skill Corporation. The courses must be aligned to the National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF).
schemes.application_process:
1. Register on the Vidya Kaushal portal.
2. Select preferred sector/role/centre.
3. Visit the chosen centre for counselling.
4. Raise a loan request through the centre.
5. Evaluate and accept/reject loan offers.
6. Loan disbursement directly to the partner/centre post-confirmation.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship

schemes.scheme_name: Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme
schemes.description: The Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme provides financial assistance to youth from specific target groups. It aims to enhance their skills and employability by covering various course-related expenses. The scheme offers need-based finance for vocational education and training courses.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for vocational education and training courses.
To enhance the skills of youth from the target group.
To improve the employability of beneficiaries through skill development.

benefits.description: Need-based finance covering up to 90% of expenses for vocational education and training courses. Maximum loan amount is Rs. 4,00,000 for courses of duration up to 2 years.
Beneficiaries are charged an interest rate of 4% per annum. Women beneficiaries receive a 0.5% interest rebate.
The loan repayment period is up to 7 years.

schemes.eligibility_description: The person should be from the target group of National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC). They must have secured admission in a vocational education and training course of minimum 6 months and up to 2 years, run or supported by a Government Ministry/Department/Organization or an organization supported by National Skill Development Corporation or State Skill Missions/Corporations. The candidate should attain a minimum age of 18 years on completion of the course.
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit the official website. 2. Click on 'How to Apply' and then 'Loan application form'. 3. Fill in all required details. 4. Save the application form.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen
schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to Ex-Servicemen or their widows for their 100% disabled child. It targets Ex-Servicemen up to the rank of Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO)/equivalent and their widows who are not receiving similar benefits from other official agencies. The assistance aims to support families caring for severely disabled children.
objectives: To provide financial support to Ex-Servicemen and their widows.
To assist families with 100% disabled children.
To ensure welfare for the dependents of those who served in the armed forces.

benefits.description: A financial assistance of Rs.3000/- per month (paid annually) per child is provided to eligible Ex-Servicemen or their widows. The assistance is non-transferable and ceases upon the child's death.

schemes.eligibility_description: The child must be a legitimate offspring of an Ex-Serviceman (ESM) or widow. The ESM should be of the rank of JCO/equivalent of the Navy/Air Force and below. The child must have 100% disability and not be receiving any other disability benefit from an official agency. Recommendation from the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB) is also required.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat (KSBS) website (ksb.gov.in) and register.
2. Fill the registration form with necessary details, upload a photo, and save.
3. Activate your account via the email link and log in to the KSB portal.
4. Select the scheme, fill the new application form, and upload copies of supporting documents duly attested by the Zila Sainik Welfare Officer (ZSWO).
5. The ZSWO scrutinizes, verifies, and forwards the application to KSB through Rajya Sainik Boards (RSBs).
6. The KSB Secretariat verifies and approves the application for payment.

documents_required.name: Photocopy of Discharge Book (with entry regarding child)
Ex-Servicemen and Dependent Identity Card issued by ZSB
100% disability certificate issued by Military / Govt hospital
Bank Account details (PNB/SBI only) and IFS Code

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Defence

schemes.scheme_name: Green Business Scheme
schemes.description: The Green Business Scheme provides financial assistance in the form of loans for income-generating activities that tackle the impacts of climate change. It covers initiatives like electric vehicles, solar energy gadgets, and poly houses to mitigate the Green House effect. The scheme is launched by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) and targets Safai Karamcharis, Scavengers, and their dependents.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for income-generating activities that promote environmental sustainability.
To support initiatives that mitigate the Green House effect and adapt to climate change impacts.
To empower Safai Karamcharis, Scavengers, and their dependents by enabling them to start green businesses.

benefits.description: Loans up to 90% of the unit cost, with a maximum of Rs. 2 lakh initially, and up to Rs. 27 lakh depending on the unit cost. Interest rates range from 2% to 7% per annum, with a 1% rebate for female beneficiaries.
Subsidy available from Special Central Assistance (SCA) or other government agencies, up to ₹10,000 or 50% of the unit cost, whichever is less, for Below Poverty Line (BPL) beneficiaries.
Loan repayment in quarterly installments over a maximum period of 10 years, including a 6-month moratorium period.

eligibility.occupation: Safai Karamcharis, Scavengers, and their Dependents

schemes.eligibility_description: Safai Karamcharis, Scavengers, and their Dependents are eligible for the scheme.
schemes.application_process:
1. Beneficiaries submit loan applications to the District Offices of State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) of NSKFDC, Branches of Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), or Nationalized Banks.
2. The District Offices of SCAs/Branches of RRBs/Nationalized Banks scrutinize these applications and send them to their Head Offices.
3. The SCAs/RRBs/Nationalized Banks appraise the viability of the project proposals and forward viable projects with their recommendations to NSKFDC.
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
schemes.description: This scheme, a component of the National Handicrafts Development Programme (NHDP) by the Ministry of Textiles, aims to support master craftspersons during their old age. It is designed to give a boost to the handicraft sector in India. Eligible artisans in indigent circumstances receive financial assistance of up to ₹8,000/- per month.
objectives: To support artisans during their old age.
To give a boost to the handicraft sector in India.
To provide financial assistance to master craftspersons in indigent circumstances.

benefits.description: Assistance of upto ₹8,000/- per month granted in the form of a monthly allowance or lump sum grant or both, disbursed via Public Financial Management System (PFMS)/Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

eligibility.disability: Age may be relaxed for artisans with disabilities

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a master craftsperson who is a recipient of a major handicrafts award (Shilp Guru, National, Merit Certificate, State, etc.). Their annual income in the preceding financial year should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-, and they should not be receiving similar financial assistance from other sources. The artisan must be at least 60 years of age, with age relaxation possible for those with disabilities.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the prescribed application form, either by print or from the Handicrafts Service Centre/Regional Office.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph, and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Submit the duly filled and signed application form and documents to the Handicrafts Service Centre/Regional Office.
4. A unique number will be assigned as an acknowledgment for future references.
5. Field officers will conduct inspections, and applications will be processed within 30 days.
6. A Core Committee will finalize the selection, and financial assistance will be disbursed through the respective field formation.

documents_required.name: Self-Attested Copy of Handicrafts Award Certificate
Affidavit Duly Attested by First-Class Magistrate

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Textiles

schemes.scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship For Students With Disabilities
schemes.description: This scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment supports regular, full-time students with disabilities. It enables them to pursue Master's degrees or Ph.D. courses from foreign universities in specified fields of study. The scheme aims to empower students with disabilities to overcome barriers, earn their livelihood, and achieve a dignified place in society.
objectives: To support students with disabilities in obtaining higher education (Master's degree or Ph.D.) from foreign universities.
To help students with disabilities harness their latent skills and prepare for earning a livelihood.
To enable students with disabilities to find a dignified place in society by overcoming physical, financial, psychological, and mental barriers.

benefits.description: Annual allowance for living expenses: $15400 for USA & other countries (except UK), 9900 GBP for UK.
Allowance for miscellaneous expenses: $1500 for USA & other countries (except UK), 1100 GBP for UK.
Actual tuition fees, visa fees, poll tax, and medical insurance premium are covered.
Air passage (economy class, shortest route), local travel (rail/bus fare), and incidental journey allowance ($20 or equivalent) are provided.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a student admitted to (or received an unconditional offer of admission for) Master's or Ph.D. courses abroad in accredited institutions. The disability percentage must be 40% or above, as defined in the 'Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016'.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download the application form from the provided link.
2. Fill the application form completely.
3. Send the duly filled application form along with copies of required documents to the Under Secretary (Scholarships), Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Room No. 516, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003.
4. Applications are accepted throughout the year.

documents_required.name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or 10th standard certificate)
Copy of PAN Card of applicant
Copy of Bank Account linked with Aadhaar No.
Copy of Certificates and mark sheets of Educational qualifications
Copy of admission papers/offer of admission from accredited universities/institutions

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship Students With Disabilities
schemes.description: This scholarship scheme by DoEPwD supports students with disabilities pursuing post-matric qualifications from UGC/AICTE recognized universities across India. It covers students from Class 11th, Class 12th, Polytechnics, Post-Matriculation Diploma/Certificates, Bachelor’s, and Master’s Degrees. The scheme aims to empower students with specified disabilities to further their education, secure a livelihood, and achieve a dignified place in society.
objectives: To support students with disabilities in pursuing higher education.
To help students prepare themselves to earn their livelihood.
To enable students to find a dignified place for themselves in society.

benefits.description: Monthly allowance ranging from ₹550 to ₹1600, varying based on the course group (e.g., Medicine, Engineering, Professional, Graduate, Non-Degree) and whether the student is a hosteller or day scholar.
Annual allowance ranging from ₹2000 to ₹4000, depending on the type of disability (e.g., Visually Impaired, Hearing Impaired, Physically Disabled, Intellectual Disabilities).
An annual allowance of ₹1500 for books.

eligibility.disability: Applicant must be disabled with 40% or above disability, as defined in the Schedule of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be pursuing a post-matric qualification (Class 11th, 12th, Polytechnics, Post-Matriculation Diploma/Certificates, Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma, or Master’s Degree in India). The applicant must not be availing any other government scholarship and must not be the third sibling in the family to have received this scholarship.
schemes.application_process:
1. Keep soft copies of required documents ready and visit http://www.scholarships.gov.in/ to register by accepting terms and clicking 'Continue'.
2. Fill the registration form, noting your Application ID and password.
3. Log in using your Application ID, password, and OTP, then create a new password.
4. On the 'Applicant’s Dashboard', click 'Application Form', fill in details, and upload documents.
5. Save as Draft to complete later or click 'Final Submit' to submit the application.

documents_required.name: Certificate of Disability (Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016)
Bank Details of the applicant or of the Parent/Guardian

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme
schemes.description: Launched on 15th August 1972, the Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs provides pension to living freedom fighters and their families. It also extends benefits to families of martyrs, serving as a token of respect for their contribution to the nation. The pension is generally for the lifetime of the recipient, with specific conditions for unmarried daughters.
objectives: To provide financial assistance and support to living freedom fighters.
To extend pension benefits to the families of deceased freedom fighters and martyrs.
To honor and acknowledge the sacrifices made by freedom fighters for India's independence.

benefits.description: Monthly pension of ₹30,900 (including 3% DR) for Ex-Andaman Political/Prisoners/Spouses.
Monthly pension of ₹28,840 (including 3% DR) for Freedom Fighters who suffered outside British India/Spouses.
Monthly pension of ₹26,780 (including 3% DR) for Other Freedom Fighters/Spouses including INA.
Monthly pension ranging from ₹13,390 to ₹15,450 (including 3% DR) for dependent parents/eligible daughters (50% of the sum admissible to the Freedom Fighter).

schemes.eligibility_description: A freedom fighter is eligible if they suffered a minimum imprisonment of six months (three months for women and SC/ST) in mainland jails before Independence, or remained underground for over six months as a proclaimed offender, or were interned/externed for six months or more. Eligibility also extends to those whose property was confiscated, who became permanently incapacitated during freedom struggle actions, or who lost their government jobs due to participation. Eligible dependents include mother, father, unremarried widow/widower, and unmarried daughters if the freedom fighter is not alive.
schemes.application_process:
1. Request a free application form from the State Government/UT concerned or the Freedom Fighters’ Division, Ministry of Home Affairs.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields on the application form and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Send the first copy of the completed application to the Chief Secretary of the concerned State Government/Union Territory Administration.
4. Send the second copy as an advance copy to the Deputy Secretary, Freedom Fighters Division, Ministry of Home Affairs, New Delhi.

documents_required.name: Certificate from jail authorities, District Magistrates or State Government (for imprisonment/detention)
Co-prisoner certificates from a sitting MP/MLA or Ex-MP/Ex-MLA (if official certificates are unavailable)
Documentary evidence of being a proclaimed offender, award for arrest, or detention order (for underground suffering)
Certificates from veteran freedom fighters (if official records are unavailable for underground suffering/internment/externment)
Order of internment or externment or other corroboratory documentary evidence
Orders of confiscation and sale of property, or dismissal/removal from service (for loss of property/job)
Specimen signature or left-hand thumb and finger impressions (for receiving pension)

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Home Affairs

schemes.scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
schemes.description: The Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India aims to provide financial assistance to school-going children from poorer OBC families. It supports students from Class 1st to 10th, offering monthly scholarships and an ad-hoc grant. The scheme targets children whose parents' annual income is below ₹2,50,000.
objectives: To award scholarships to school-going children of poorer OBC parents.
To support the education of OBC students from Class 1st to 10th in India.
To promote educational attainment and reduce dropout rates among Other Backward Classes.

benefits.description: Monthly scholarship of ₹500 for 10 months for hostellers in Class 3rd to 10th.
Monthly scholarship of ₹100 for 10 months for day scholars in Class 1st to 10th.
An annual ad-hoc grant of ₹500 per student for both hostellers and day scholars.

schemes.eligibility_description: The scholarship is for students whose parents/guardians' annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹2,50,000. It is tenable only in institutions recognized by State/UT Governments, requiring a minimum of 60% attendance in the previous year. Beneficiaries cannot avail other pre-matric scholarships, and there are reservations for girl students (30%) and students with disabilities (5%).
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the National Scholarship Portal and click "New Registration" to read guidelines and continue.
2. Fill the mandatory fields in the registration form, then click "Register" to get your Application ID and password.
3. Login to the portal using your Application ID, password, and CAPTCHA, then verify with OTP and reset your password.
4. Access the "Applicant’s Dashboard," navigate to "Application Form," fill in details, upload documents, and either "Save as Draft" or "Final Submit."

documents_required.name: Details of the Aadhaar-linked Bank Account

schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.scheme_name: Scheme For Financial Assistance For Veteran Artists
schemes.description: This scheme, launched by the Ministry of Culture, aims to improve the financial and socio-economic status of old artists and scholars. It targets individuals who have significantly contributed to arts and letters but are now facing financial hardship due to old age. Financial assistance is provided as a monthly allowance to support their livelihood.
objectives: To improve the financial and socio-economic status of old artists and scholars.
