To provide monthly financial assistance to artists and scholars in penury conditions.
To recognize and support individuals who have significantly contributed to arts, letters, and other specialized fields.

benefits.description: A total allowance of ₹6000/- per month will be given to an eligible beneficiary. The Centre and State Government/UT Administration concerned will share this allowance.

In case of the death of a beneficiary, the financial assistance may be transferred to the spouse of the beneficiary till life, at the discretion of the Central Government, provided a request is received within one year of death.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must have made significant contributions to art and letters, including traditional scholars. Their personal income (including spouse's) must not exceed ₹4,000 per month or ₹48,000 annually, excluding existing government pension. Applicants must be at least 60 years old (not applicable for spouse) and either receive a minimum ₹500 monthly pension from their State/UT or be recommended by Zonal Cultural Centres if no state pension exists. They should not be receiving financial assistance under other Ministry schemes.
schemes.application_process:
1. Apply online through the Registration/login Page of "Culture Scheme Monitoring System (CSMS)" on the Ministry of Culture website under "MOC Schemes Application".
2. Eligible applications undergo physical inspection/verification by officer(s) of the Ministry of Culture or its organizations.
3. An Expert Committee reviews applications based on guidelines, financial position, and eminence, recommending deserving candidates.
4. Recommendations are examined by the Administration Division and submitted for approval by the Competent Authority.
5. Financial assistance is disbursed monthly via Public Financial Management System (PFMS)/Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) or a Service Provider directly to bank accounts.
6. Beneficiaries must submit a Digital Life Certificate annually (in November) and a Coloured scanned copy of the original Income Certificate every five years.

documents_required.name: Recent passport-size photograph (not older than six months)
Self-attested copy of address proof (e.g., Aadhaar Card, Elector’s photo identity card, Passport, Driving License, Utility Bill)
Self-attested copy of Date of Birth proof (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Birth Certificate, Matriculation/10th class certificate)
Self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card issued by UIDAI
Original Income Certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure-II(A)) issued by the Competent Authority of the State/UTs concerned
Copies of relevant documents supporting applicant’s contributions in Art/Culture or awards/recognition received
Duly filled-in and signed prescribed Bank Authorization letter (Annexure-IV), verified & signed by the Bank Manager (original)
Recommendation letter obtained from the Culture Department of the concerned State Government/UT

schemes.helpline: Section Officer: (011)-24642165; LIC Enquiries: 23708275, 23705953; Fax: 23350832; Email: bo_g103[at]licindia[dot]com
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Culture

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhya mantri Krishak Udyami Yojana
schemes.description: The Mukhya Mantri Krishak Udyami Yojana provides financial assistance through loans to sons and daughters of farmers in Madhya Pradesh to establish their businesses. It aims to make economically weak farmers self-reliant by overcoming financial hurdles. The scheme offers capital cost subsidies and interest subsidies to inspire citizens to set up businesses and reduce unemployment.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to sons and daughters of farmers to establish their businesses.
Enable economically weak farmers to become self-reliant by setting up their own ventures.
Reduce the unemployment rate in the state by encouraging entrepreneurship among citizens.

benefits.description: For projects worth Rs 10 lakh or more: 15% (maximum ₹12 lakh) for general class, 20% (maximum ₹18 lakh) for BPL category. For projects less than Rs 10 lakh: 15% (maximum ₹1 lakh) for general category, 30% (maximum ₹2 lakh) for BPL/SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities/Disabled. Additional 30% (maximum ₹3 lakh) for liberated nomadic/semi-nomadic tribes, and 20% (maximum ₹1 lakh) for Bhopal Gas victim family members.

6% per annum for women entrepreneurs and 5% per annum for male entrepreneurs, for a maximum of 7 years. For projects of ₹10 lakh or more, maximum ₹5 lakh per annum. For projects less than ₹10 lakh, maximum ₹25,000 per annum.
Guarantee fee will be payable at the prevailing rate for a maximum of 7 years.

schemes.eligibility_description: The parents of the beneficiary should not have their agricultural land. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer. Minimum educational qualification required is 10th class.
schemes.application_process: 1. Visit the official website and click on the application link for the scheme. 2. Choose the department that interests you. 3. Register as a new applicant by entering your name, mobile number, password, and captcha code. 4. Submit the registration details to create an account on the portal. 5. Log in to the portal using your credentials and proceed to apply for the scheme.
schemes.ministry: Department of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Madhya Pradesh government

schemes.scheme_name: Savitribai Phule Self-Help Scheme
schemes.description: The Savitribai Phule Self-Help Scheme, managed by the District Intermediate Cooperative Development Committee, supports women entrepreneurs from the SC category in Madhya Pradesh. It offers margin money assistance of up to ₹15,000 (50% of the project cost, with a maximum project cost of ₹50,000). This financial aid helps them start small businesses across various sectors.
objectives: To support women entrepreneurs from the Scheduled Caste category in Madhya Pradesh.
To provide financial assistance in the form of margin money for starting small businesses.
To promote self-employment and economic empowerment among eligible women.

benefits.description: Financial support covering 50% of the project cost, up to a maximum of ₹15,000, for starting small businesses.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be literate and should not have any outstanding defaults with any nationalized bank, cooperative bank, or other financial institution.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit an online center in your district.
2. Apply through the official portal: https://scwelfare.mponline.gov.in.
3. Submit the necessary documents for verification.
4. Await approval and financial disbursement upon successful application.
schemes.ministry: District Intermediate Cooperative Development Committee

schemes.scheme_name: Research Scholarship for Disabled Students
schemes.description: The "Research Scholarship for Disabled Students" scheme, implemented by the Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, offers financial support for PhD research to differently-abled students. Eligible candidates receive ₹16,000/- per month, totaling ₹1,92,000/- per year, directly transferred to their bank accounts. This scholarship aims to support 10 students annually in their pursuit of higher education and research.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to differently-abled students pursuing PhD research.
To encourage higher education and research among disabled students in Madhya Pradesh.
To support 10 eligible students annually with a monthly scholarship for their PhD studies.

benefits.description: Monthly scholarship of ₹16,000/- (₹1,92,000/- annually) for PhD research.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be natives of Madhya Pradesh, registered for PhD research at any recognized university in India following an interview with the Research Degree Committee, and hold a postgraduate degree with minimum qualifying marks as per UGC guidelines. The annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.
schemes.application_process:
1. The Directorate of Higher Education issues an advertisement for the scheme.
2. Applications received are scrutinized.
3. Applicants are selected within the prescribed quota limit of 10 students per year.
4. With the approval of the Commissioner of Higher Education, the scholarship amount is transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.

documents_required.name: Disability certificate issued by competent authority

schemes.ministry: Higher Education Department

schemes.scheme_name: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
schemes.description: The Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial support to disabled children. It aims to promote and facilitate inclusive education for persons with disabilities (Divyangjan), ensuring equal access to quality educational opportunities.
objectives: Provide financial support to disabled children for their education.
Promote and facilitate inclusive education for persons with disabilities (Divyangjan).
Ensure equal access to quality education and educational opportunities for individuals with disabilities.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹600.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be a native of Madhya Pradesh, aged between 6 and 18 years, with a disability percentage of 40% or more. Their name must be mentioned on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal.
schemes.application_process:
1. Apply using the prescribed format and submit necessary documents to the designated officer's office, Gram Panchayat, or Public Service Center.
2. Receive an acknowledgment upon submitting a complete application.
3. The District Panchayat/Gram Panchayat/Urban Body/Ward Office will scrutinize the submitted documents.
4. If documents are found to be correct, the pension case will be approved according to rules.
5. The beneficiary's name will be added to the pension proposal for the current month.
6. The Directorate will deposit the monthly pension amount directly into the beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi
schemes.description: The "Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi" scheme, launched by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides residential and other essential facilities. It targets Scheduled Caste students from Madhya Pradesh pursuing higher education in Delhi. The scheme aims to support these students by covering expenses like rent, scholarships, and utility costs.
objectives: To provide residential facilities for Scheduled Caste students from Madhya Pradesh studying in Delhi.
To cover essential expenses such as water, electricity, and provide a scholarship.
To facilitate higher education access for eligible students by reducing financial burdens.

benefits.description: Covers monthly rent (₹1,000), scholarship (₹500), and water/electricity expenses (₹100).
Provided at the time of admission.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh and belong to the Scheduled Caste category. They should be a regular student currently enrolled in or admitted to an undergraduate (first year) or higher class, or a professional course at a government or recognized institution located in Delhi.
schemes.application_process:
1. After taking admission in higher education institutions located in Delhi, submit the application.
2. The application has to be submitted to the Residential Commissioner, Madhya Pradesh Bhawan, New Delhi.
3. Eligible students must submit the application in the prescribed Form-A.
4. Submit the application through the concerned institution to the Special Commissioner, Madhya Pradesh.
schemes.ministry: Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana
schemes.description: This scheme, launched by the Tribal Welfare Department of Madhya Pradesh, aims to motivate Scheduled Tribe girls towards higher education. It provides an annual monetary incentive to girls who pass Class 10th and enroll in Class 11th. The objective is to increase their interest in education and encourage progression to higher classes.
objectives: To motivate girls towards education.
To increase the interest of Scheduled Tribe girls in Madhya Pradesh towards education.
To encourage Scheduled Tribe girls to pursue education in higher classes.

benefits.description: Eligible Scheduled Tribe girls who pass Class 10th and enter Class 11th will receive an annual incentive of ₹3,000, disbursed directly into their bank accounts.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a girl, a native/resident of Madhya Pradesh, belong to the Scheduled Tribe community, and be a regular student who has passed Class 10th and is entering Class 11th.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official Madhya Pradesh Shiksha Portal and complete eKYC using your mobile number, OTP, and Samagra ID.
2. Enter your Aadhaar number and complete Aadhaar eKYC with an OTP.
3. Log in to the portal using your username and password.
4. Select the 'Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana' scheme.
5. Fill in personal details like name, father's name, Samagra ID, Aadhaar, and bank account information.
6. Upload required documents such as photo, signature, and other necessary certificates, then submit the application.
schemes.ministry: Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme (Class 12th Passed)
schemes.description: The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme, launched by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to motivate and economically support students from lower economic backgrounds. It provides a cash award of ₹5,000/- to students who achieve the highest marks in the 12th class examination from government schools within their district. Eligibility requires parents' annual income to be less than ₹1,00,000/-.
objectives: To motivate meritorious students from lower economic backgrounds.
To provide financial assistance to top-performing Class 12 students.
To recognize academic excellence among students in Madhya Pradesh government schools.

benefits.description: A cash award of ₹5,000/- is given to students who achieve the highest marks in the 12th class examination in government schools within their district. The scholarship is sent directly to the student's bank account.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. The student must have achieved the highest marks in their district in the Class 12 examination from a government school in Madhya Pradesh. The student's parents' income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year.
schemes.application_process:
1. Eligible students should contact the Principal of their respective government schools/institutions.
2. The teacher of the educational institution will enter the student's profile on the education portal (https://shikshaportal.mp.gov.in/) using the provided records and certificates.
schemes.ministry: School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship
schemes.description: The Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship, offered by the Madhya Pradesh government, supports economically disadvantaged students pursuing higher education. It aims to cover tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other educational expenses. This scheme empowers deserving students to achieve academic and professional excellence, fostering their socio-economic development.
objectives: To support students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds in pursuing higher education.
To alleviate financial constraints by covering tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other educational expenses.
To empower deserving students to excel academically and professionally, fostering their socio-economic development and contributing to the overall advancement of society.

benefits.description: Hostel students receive a subsistence allowance of ₹1,200 per month.
Non-hostel residents are provided with a subsistence allowance of ₹650 per month.
Reimbursement of mandatory and non-refundable fees.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be studying in graduate/post-graduate courses. The maximum annual income of the guardian should be ₹2,50,000 for post-matric scholarships and ₹6,00,000 for top class scholarships. Applicants must have 40 percent or more disability.
schemes.application_process:
1. Go to the official website of the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and click "New Registration".
2. Read guidelines, select Aadhaar category, enter mobile number, OTP, and captcha for verification.
3. Fill in required personal details including Scholarship Category, State, Name, Date of birth, Gender, and Contact details.
4. Submit registration to receive your Student Application ID.
5. Log in using your Application ID, Password, and Captcha.
6. Complete and submit the application form with all necessary details.
schemes.ministry: Higher Education Department, Madhya Pradesh Government

schemes.scheme_name: Pratibha Yojana
schemes.description: The Pratibha Yojana, launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial assistance to talented Scheduled Tribe students. It encourages them to pursue higher education after passing national competitive examinations. The scheme supports students admitted to premier institutions like IIT, NIT, NLU, AIIMS, NDA, and government MBBS colleges in Madhya Pradesh.
objectives: To encourage talented Scheduled Tribe students from Madhya Pradesh for higher education.
To provide financial assistance to eligible students who qualify national competitive examinations.
To support students admitted to prestigious educational institutions across India.

benefits.description: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- for students whose annual parental income is up to ₹3,00,000/-.
Financial assistance of ₹25,000/- for students whose annual parental income exceeds ₹3,00,000/-.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must have qualified in national competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, or NDA, and secured admission in institutions like IIT, NIT, NLU, AIIMS, NDA, or government MBBS colleges in Madhya Pradesh. The applicant's Aadhaar must be linked to their bank account, and they must possess the admission receipt.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register a new beneficiary profile on the official website of the Tribal Welfare Department of Madhya Pradesh via MPTAASC.
2. Complete all mandatory fields and upload required documents during registration.
3. Receive your user ID and password via email/SMS.
4. Log in to the MPTAASC portal using your credentials.
5. Navigate to 'PMS', select 'Apply for Scheme', fill out the application form, and upload necessary documents.
6. Submit the application and print a copy for your records.

documents_required.name: Proof of admission in the institution

schemes.ministry: Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students
schemes.description: The Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students scheme, by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial assistance to backward class students studying at the pre-matriculation level. It offers monthly scholarships to eligible students to help them complete their education. Applications are processed through educational institutions and the scheme is implemented across the entire state of Madhya Pradesh.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to backward class students.
To support students studying at the pre-matriculation level.
To help eligible students complete their education through monthly scholarships.

benefits.description: Monthly scholarship for students in classes 6th to 8th: Boys ₹20, Girls ₹30. Awarded for 10 months annually, paid in one installment on 30th September.
Monthly scholarship for students in classes 9th to 10th: Boys ₹30, Girls ₹40. Awarded for 10 months annually, paid in one installment on 30th September.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a student of classes 6th to 10th. Parents/guardians should not be income taxpayers and should not own more than 10 acres of land. Applicant must belong to the Backward Class and reside in Madhya Pradesh.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Head of the Educational Institution to request the hard copy of the application form.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph, and attach self-attested copies of all mandatory documents.
3. Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the concerned authority within the prescribed period.
4. Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority, ensuring it contains essential submission details.

documents_required.name: Land Ownership Proof (Showing Less Than 10 Acres of Land)
Application Form in the Prescribed Format
Bonafide Certificate or Proof of Admission in School
Proof of Age or Date of Birth (e.g., Birth Certificate or School Records)

schemes.ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Sanskrit Scholarship
schemes.description: The Sanskrit Scholarship scheme, implemented by the Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to promote the Sanskrit language by providing financial assistance to students. It offers a monthly scholarship of ₹300 for 10 months to students studying Sanskrit at various levels in government or aided non-government colleges. Eligible students must be Madhya Pradesh natives with a family income not exceeding ₹54,000 per year.
objectives: To promote the Sanskrit language in Madhya Pradesh.
To provide financial assistance to students pursuing Sanskrit education.
To support students studying Sanskrit at various academic levels in colleges.

benefits.description: Students studying Sanskrit at Post Graduate, Acharya, Graduate, Shastri, Uttar Madhyama, Purva Madhyama, and Prathama levels receive ₹300 per month for 10 months, transferred directly to their bank account.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be students studying Sanskrit at various levels (Post Graduate, Acharya, Graduate, Shastri, Uttar Madhyama, Purva Madhyama, and Prathama) in any government or aided non-government college. Academic qualifications vary by level: 50% marks for Post Graduate (degree), Acharya (Shastri), and Graduate (10+2); 45% for Shastri (Purva Madhyama) and Uttar Madhyama (Prathma); and merit-based for Purva Madhyama (5th examination).
schemes.application_process:
1. The Directorate of Higher Education issues an advertisement for the scheme.
2. Applications received are scrutinized.
3. Applicants are selected within the prescribed quota limits.
4. The Commissioner of Higher Education approves the selections.
5. The scholarship amount is transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.ministry: Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana
schemes.description: This scheme is an educational scholarship initiative by the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Board. It aims to provide financial assistance to children of workers/employees in the state who are unable to pursue education due to weak economic conditions. The scheme supports students from Class 5th up to various graduation and post-graduation courses.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for education to children of workers/employees in Madhya Pradesh.
To support students from economically weaker sections to continue their studies.
To ensure access to education for eligible children whose parents contribute to the Labor Welfare Fund.

benefits.description: Scholarship amount fixed for each class is provided to students studying in Class 5th to 12th, Graduation, Post Graduation, ITI, Polytechnic, PGDCA, DCA (Computer Course), B.E., M.B.B.S. M.Sc.
The scholarship amount will be paid by e-payment through the Regional Office after the approval of the Welfare Commissioner, as per bank details provided.

eligibility.occupation: Children of workers/employees in institutions/establishments governed by M.P. Labor Welfare Fund Act 1982.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. The parents of the applicant must be working in a factory or institution established in Madhya Pradesh under the Labor Welfare Fund Act 1982. Only 2 children in a family are eligible. Children of officers and employees in managerial capacities are not eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Go to the scholarship portal of the Student Labor Welfare Board.
2. Click on "Do Registration" under registration.
3. Fill out the academic scholarship application form online.
4. Authenticate identity by providing own and parent's Aadhaar numbers.
5. Submit the online application within the time limit set by the board, including mandatory documents.

documents_required.name: Latest passport-size photograph of the applicant
Previous year's mark sheet of the class passed by the applicant
Photocopy of the first page of the applicant's bank passbook (showing name, account number, IFS code)

schemes.ministry: Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Board

schemes.scheme_name: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)
schemes.description: The "State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)" scheme, launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students. It provides scholarships to eligible students studying in Classes 9 and 10. The scheme targets native students of Madhya Pradesh belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category, with no family income restrictions.
objectives: To encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students.
To improve the educational status of Scheduled Tribe students.
To provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10.

benefits.description: Annual scholarship of ₹600 for boys and ₹1,300 for girls studying in Classes 9 and 10. The amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a student, a native of Madhya Pradesh, studying in Class 9 or Class 10, and belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. There is no restriction on annual family income. Students are eligible even if they fail for one year, and reapplication is not required for scholarship renewal.
schemes.application_process: 1. Eligible students should contact the Principal of their respective schools/institutions. 2. The teacher of the educational institution will enter the student's profile on the education portal (shikshaportal.mp.gov.in) based on the records/certificates provided by the student.
schemes.ministry: Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th (Scheduled Caste)
schemes.description: Launched in 1966-67 by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, this scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students. It aims to encourage their education by offering a scholarship amount to regular students enrolled in Class 1st to 5th in recognized institutions.
objectives: Encourage Scheduled Caste students in the field of education.
Provide financial assistance to eligible students.
Support regular students enrolled in Class 1st to 5th in recognized institutions.

benefits.description: Annual scholarship of ₹200 for eligible Scheduled Caste students.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh, belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category, and be a regular student enrolled in Class 1 to 5 in a recognized educational institution.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Departmental District Officer to request the hard copy of the application form.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph, and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the authority within the prescribed period.
4. Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority, ensuring it contains essential submission details.
schemes.ministry: Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Super 5000
schemes.description: The Super 5000 scheme, part of Madhya Pradesh's Jan Kalyan Sambal Yojana, provides an education incentive to the top 5000 students from unorganized sector worker families. These meritorious students, who achieve maximum marks in 10th and 12th board examinations, receive financial assistance to support their further studies.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to academically meritorious students in Madhya Pradesh.
To encourage students from unorganized sector worker families to pursue higher education.
To recognize and reward academic excellence demonstrated in 10th and 12th board examinations.

benefits.description: One-time scholarship amount for further studies.

schemes.eligibility_description: Children of labor families native to Madhya Pradesh, registered in the unorganized sector. Students must have passed the 10th/12th board examination from the Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education in a government school and be among the top 5000 in the state merit list. The construction worker parent's age must be between 18 and 60 years.
schemes.application_process:
1. Applicant students must contact their school principal or district labour department.
2. Obtain the application form.
3. Fill out the application form in the prescribed manner.
4. Attach the required documents.
5. Submit the application.

schemes.scheme_name: Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools
schemes.description: The "Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools" scheme, launched by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to support the education of students from specific communities. It provides financial assistance by reimbursing tuition fees for those admitted to Sainik Schools or other recognized institutions. The scheme specifically targets students belonging to De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for education to students from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities.
To encourage enrollment of eligible students in Sainik Schools or similar institutions.
To alleviate the financial burden of tuition fees for underprivileged families in Madhya Pradesh.

benefits.description: Reimbursement of tuition fees for students admitted to Sainik Schools or Institutions.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be from a Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic Community, be a student, and be enrolled in a Sainik School or institution.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the "Samarth Portal" and register by providing mandatory details.
2. Log in using the credentials created during registration.
3. Navigate to the online application form for the scheme.
4. Fill in all mandatory fields and upload all required documents in the specified format.
5. Carefully review all provided information and make any necessary corrections.
6. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, then submit your application.

documents_required.name: Proof of Enrolment into a Sainik School / Institution

schemes.ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Aawaas Sahayata
schemes.description: Launched in 2016 by the Department of Tribal Affairs, Government of Madhya Pradesh, the Aawaas Sahayata scheme provides housing assistance. It targets tribal boys and girls pursuing higher education outside their hometowns who have passed 12th grade and are enrolled in specific courses. The scheme is for students who have not secured admission in a government hostel.
objectives: To provide housing assistance to tribal students.
To support tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns.
To assist students who have not secured admission in government hostels.

benefits.description: Provides housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostels are unavailable.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be native tribal students of Madhya Pradesh, pursuing higher education outside their hometowns. They should have passed 12th grade from a government or non-government college and be regularly admitted to graduate, graduate diploma, technical, or paramedical courses, without having secured admission in a government hostel.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Madhya Pradesh Tribal Affairs & Scheduled Caste Welfare Automation System (MPTAAS) portal.
2. Register a new beneficiary profile by filling in all required details and uploading documents.
3. Submit the registration form and receive a registration number.
4. Log in to the MPTAAS portal using your user ID, password, and captcha code.
5. Choose the Aawaas Sahayata scheme, enter all required information, and upload necessary documents.
6. Submit the application to complete the process.
schemes.ministry: Department of Tribal Affairs, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)
schemes.description: The Gausevak Training scheme by the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to empower educated unemployed rural youth with self-employment opportunities. It provides them with skills to offer primary veterinary services in remote rural areas. The scheme fully funds initial and refresher training, including stipends and study materials.
objectives: To empower educated unemployed rural youth.
To provide self-employment opportunities in rural areas.
To equip youth with skills for primary veterinary services in remote areas.

benefits.description: Covers training cost of ₹6,000 and a stipend of ₹1,200 for six months (₹1,000 per month).
A kit worth ₹1,200 is fully funded by the department for initial training.
A stipend of ₹500 is provided for refresher training.
Study material worth ₹100 is fully funded by the department for refresher training.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant should be from a rural area, have passed the 10th standard, and be a cow-helper.
schemes.application_process:
1. For Initial Training, applicants from each Gram Panchayat will be selected on the approval of Janpad Panchayat.
2. For Refresher Training, Gausevaks who have received initial training will be selected based on seniority.
3. For queries and documentation requirements, applicants should contact the Nearest Veterinary Officer, Incharge of the veterinary dispensary, or Deputy Director, Veterinary Medicine.
schemes.ministry: Animal Husbandry Department

schemes.scheme_name: 6 Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
schemes.scheme_name_hindi: Chhe Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
schemes.description: This scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance to multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped persons above six years of age. It offers ₹600 per month as a grant-in-aid to help them meet special needs and support their livelihood, addressing the difficulties faced by their families in their care.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped persons.
To support the livelihood and special needs of disabled individuals above six years of age.
To alleviate the financial burden on families caring for such disabled persons.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹600 for livelihood and special needs.

eligibility.disability: 40 percent or more disability, multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh, have a certificate of 40 percent or more disability, be registered on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal, and be above six years of age.
schemes.application_process:
1. Applicants can apply for the scheme using the prescribed format and submitting necessary documents either to the designated officer's office, Gram Panchayat, or a Public Service Center.
2. Upon submitting a complete application, the applicant will receive a mandatory acknowledgment.
3. The District Panchayat/Gram Panchayat/Urban Body/Ward Office will scrutinize the submitted documents.
4. If documents are found correct after investigation, the pension case will be approved according to the rules.
5. Once approved, the beneficiary's name will be added to the pension proposal for the current month.
6. The Directorate will deposit the monthly pension amount directly into the beneficiary's bank savings account through a single click.

documents_required.name: Native resident certificate of Madhya Pradesh
Disability certificate (as per Persons with Disabilities Act 1995, describing multiple disabilities and underdevelopment)

schemes.ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.description: Launched on 1st April 2009, this welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance to disabled individuals. It targets those living below the poverty line, with pension amounts funded by the Government of India through the National Social Assistance Program (NSAP).
objectives: To provide financial assistance to disabled individuals.
To support persons with disabilities living below the poverty line.
To ensure social security for eligible disabled residents of Madhya Pradesh.

benefits.description: Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹600.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh, a person with 80% or more disability, aged between 18 and 79 years, and belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. They should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Gram Panchayat or Public Service Center to request the prescribed application form.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph, and attach self-attested copies of necessary documents.
3. Submit the application and receive an acknowledgement receipt.
4. Submitted documents will be verified by the District Panchayat/Gram Panchayat/Urban Body or Ward Office.
5. Upon approval, the applicant’s name will be added to the pension proposal for that month.

documents_required.name: Identity Proof (Voter ID Card or Driving License)
Below Poverty Line (BPL) Card/ Ration Card

schemes.ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme-Madhya Pradesh
schemes.description: Launched in 2009, the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh. It provides financial support to eligible widows in Madhya Pradesh who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension amount contributed by both Central and State governments.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to widows in Madhya Pradesh.
To empower and support widows from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
To ensure social security and improve the living standards of vulnerable widows.

benefits.description: Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹ 600/-.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a domicile of Madhya Pradesh, aged between 40 to 79 years, and belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
schemes.application_process:
1. Apply offline at Gram Panchayat/Janpad Panchayat (rural) or Nagar Panchayat/municipal council/municipal corporation office (urban) with required documents and photographs, or apply online through a nearest Loksewa Kendra.
2. Fill all mandatory fields of the application form, attach all self-attested mandatory documents, and submit them to the designated receiving authority.
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana
schemes.description: The Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana, launched by the Energy Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial relief to domestic consumers. It subsidizes electricity bills for those whose monthly consumption does not exceed 150 units, ensuring easy access through the billing system.
objectives: To provide financial relief to domestic consumers.
To subsidize electricity bills for low energy consumption.
To ensure easy access to subsidies through the billing system.

benefits.description: Consumers with a monthly electricity consumption of up to 150 units receive a subsidized bill, minimizing their energy expenses.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of Madhya Pradesh, domestic consumers with a monthly electricity consumption of up to 150 units, and have an approved load of 1 kilowatt for their electricity connection.
schemes.application_process: 1. The scheme benefits are automatically applied to eligible consumers. 2. Enrollment is automatic through the billing system.
schemes.ministry: Energy Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Tap Water Scheme (Nal Jal Yojana)
schemes.description: The Tap Water Scheme (Nal Jal Yojana) by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide clean and accessible tap water connections in Gram Panchayat areas. Beneficiaries apply to their local Gram Panchayat, receive a connection upon approval, and pay a monthly water tax. The application process can be completed online.
objectives: To provide clean and accessible tap water connections to residents.
To ensure water supply in Gram Panchayat areas across Madhya Pradesh.
To facilitate an online application process for household water connections.

benefits.description: Provision of a tap water connection by the Gram Panchayat.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh and belong to a Gram Panchayat area where the scheme is implemented.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Official Website of "Panchayat Darpan 2.0" by the Panchayat & Rural Development Department.
2. Under "Online Services" click "Water Connection Application".
3. Fill in all mandatory fields and upload required documents in the specified format and size.
4. Review all information, make corrections if necessary, and click "Submit Application". Note the Application Number.
5. After Gram Panchayat examination and approval, deposit the prescribed fee before the due date.
6. Connection Permission will be issued by the Gram Panchayat upon fee deposit.

documents_required.name: Details of Outstanding Taxes Payable to Gram Panchayat

schemes.ministry: Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Usha Kiran Yojana
schemes.description: The Usha Kiran Yojana is a state government scheme in Madhya Pradesh aimed at providing protection and assistance to victims of domestic violence. It targets women of all age groups and children under 18 years who experience various forms of abuse. The scheme helps implement the Women's Protection from Domestic Violence Act 2005.
objectives: To provide protection against domestic violence to women and children.
To offer assistance and support to victims of domestic violence.
To implement the provisions of the Women's Protection from Domestic Violence Act 2005 and Rule 2006.

benefits.description: Provides protection and support to women and children against domestic violence.

schemes.eligibility_description: All women of all age groups and all children under the age of 18 who are victims of domestic violence are eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Applicants must visit a Protection Officer (Project Officer-Integrated Child Development Project Office).
2. Alternatively, applicants can visit a One Stop Center operated in the district.
3. Another option is to visit a Police Station to apply.

schemes.scheme_name: LIDCOM Gattai Stall Scheme
schemes.description: The LIDCOM Gattai Stall Scheme, implemented by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Government of Maharashtra, targets economically weak Scheduled Caste Charmakar cobblers. It provides a 100% subsidy for the erection of a tin stall, including incidental charges, to roadside cobblers who are permanent residents of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to uplift the lifestyle and promote the educational, economic, and social development of the Charmakar community.
objectives: To uplift the lifestyle of economically weak Charmakars (Dhor, Chambhar, Holar, Mochi, etc.) who are below the poverty line.
To develop the Charmakar community educationally, economically, and socially.
To give the Charmakar community a respectable place in society.

benefits.description: 100% subsidy for the erection of a Tin Stall (4’ x 5’ x 6.5’) costing ₹16,367/- per stall, plus ₹500/- incidental charges.

eligibility.caste: Charmakar Community (Dhor, Chambhar, Holar, Mochi, etc.)

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a citizen of India, have knowledge of the business for which they have applied, and be identified as a Roadside Cobbler by the Gram Panchayat.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the application form from the District Office of LIDCOM.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields, paste a signed passport-sized photograph, and attach all self-attested mandatory documents.
3. Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the District Office.
4. Acquire the receipt/acknowledgment of successful submission from the District Office.

documents_required.name: Proof of Age (Birth Certificate, Marksheet of Class 10th/12th, etc)
Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra
Proof of being a Roadside Cobbler (issued by Gram Panchayat)
Income Certificate issued by an Authorised Govt. Officer
Caste Certificate issued by an Authorised Govt. Officer
Details of the Bank Account (Bank Name, Branch Name, Address, IFSC, etc)

schemes.ministry: Government of Maharashtra

schemes.scheme_name: Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses
schemes.description: This scheme, launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), aims to provide financial assistance for educational pursuits. It supports children and wives of registered construction workers who are enrolled in government-recognized diploma or postgraduate diploma courses. The assistance helps cover educational expenses, promoting access to higher education for this demographic.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for government-recognized diploma courses.
To support the educational aspirations of children and wives of registered construction workers.
To encourage enrollment in diploma and postgraduate diploma programs among eligible beneficiaries.

benefits.description: ₹20,000/- per year for Government Recognized Diploma Courses.
₹25,000/- per year for Postgraduate Diploma Courses.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra and either a child or spouse of a construction worker registered under the MBOCWW. The applicant must also be enrolled in a government-recognized diploma or postgraduate diploma course. The benefit applies to a maximum of two children and to the wife of registered male workers.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download the application form from the MBOCWW official website.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields and attach self-attested copies of required documents.
3. Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the Labor Commissioner/Government Labor Officer.
4. Request a receipt or acknowledgment containing submission details.

documents_required.name: Identity Card of Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Marksheet/School Certificate of passing in the previous academic level
Acknowledgment/Bonafide for admission in the current academic year
Proof of Residence (Aadhaar Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Ration Sheet/Last Month's Electricity Bill/Gram Panchayat Certificate)

schemes.ministry: Labour Department Maharashtra

schemes.scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the Children Studying in 1st to 7th and 8th to 10th Class
schemes.description: This scheme, implemented by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers. It offers ₹2,500 for children in 1st to 7th standard and ₹5,000 for those in 8th to 10th standard. The assistance covers up to two children and the wife of a registered male worker.
objectives: To provide financial support for the education of children of registered construction workers.
To encourage school enrollment and retention among children from construction worker families.
To improve the educational outcomes for dependents of registered construction workers in Maharashtra.

benefits.description: For children studying in 1st to 7th standard.
For children studying in 8th to 10th standard.

schemes.eligibility_description: The worker must be engaged in building or other construction work and registered under the Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. The children or a registered male worker's wife must be enrolled in any grade from Class 1st to 10th. Only two children or a registered male worker's wife will be entitled to scholarships.
schemes.application_process:

To support the nominated heirs of deceased registered construction workers.
To ensure the welfare of construction workers and their families in Maharashtra.

It provides financial assistance through loans at a low interest rate for educational, economic, and social development. Provide educational, economic, and social development to beneficiaries.
Ensure a respectable position in society for Charmakars.

To provide financial assistance for H.S.C., Degree, Professional, Technical, Medical, and Engineering courses.
To support the educational aspirations of permanent residents of Maharashtra with disabilities.

benefits.description: Provides monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹230 to ₹1200 for hostellers and day scholars across various course groups (HSC, Diploma, Degree, PG).
Offers monthly allowance for blind and low-vision students, ranging from ₹50 to ₹100 depending on the course group.
Covers tuition fees as approved by the competent authority.
Provides an annual allowance of ₹500 for study tours and ₹600 for project typing.

The applicant should have passed class 10th and not failed in the last qualifying examination.

To offer vocational training to special children above 18 years of age.
To ensure access to free food, shelter, clothing, and education in government institutions for beneficiaries.

Vocational training for special children aged 18 years and above.
Provision of free food, shelter, and clothing facilities in these institutions.

schemes.scheme_name: Providing Tin stalls to Gatai Kamgar
schemes.description: "Providing Tin Stalls to Gatai Kamgar" is a social welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance of the Government of Maharashtra. It aims to uplift Scheduled Caste individuals engaged in leather footwear production and leather goods preparation. The scheme offers 100% government-funded tin stalls and provides ₹500 as financial assistance to protect beneficiaries from heat, rain, and wind.
objectives: To uplift Scheduled Caste individuals engaged in leather footwear production and leather goods preparation.
To provide 100% government-funded tin stalls to beneficiaries for their livelihood.
To offer financial assistance to help protect beneficiaries from adverse weather conditions like heat, rain, and wind.

100% government-funded tin stalls are provided for livelihood activities.

The place for the stall must be rented, leased, purchased, officially provided by a local body, or owned by the applicant.

schemes.scheme_name: Samagr Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana
schemes.description: The Samagr Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana in Madhya Pradesh provides financial assistance to poor, disabled, and destitute citizens. It aims to offer social security to vulnerable groups including the elderly, handicapped, disabled, and poor, ensuring they can meet their basic needs independently. The scheme covers various beneficiaries from women to children, focusing on those who are most in need of support.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to destitute citizens.
Ensure self-reliance for vulnerable populations.
Offer social security to the elderly, disabled, widows, and poor.

benefits.description: Monthly pension amount.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of Madhya Pradesh. Eligibility includes destitute-aged people above 60 years; widows (Kalyani) above 18 years and not income taxpayers; unmarried women above 50 years and not income taxpayers; abandoned women aged 18-59 years living below the poverty line; disabled persons aged 6-18 years with 40% or more disability and not income taxpayers; or inmates of old age homes above 60 years.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the Gram Panchayat / Janpad Panchayat in rural areas or Municipal Corporation / Municipality / City Council in urban areas.
2. Obtain and fill the application form with the required information.

schemes.scheme_name: Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana
schemes.description: The Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana is an initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to provide free residential education to children of construction workers employed in the informal sector. Under this scheme, two children of registered workers between the ages of 6 and 16 receive free education in dedicated schools. The scheme aims to improve their standard of living and provide opportunities for success.
objectives: To provide free residential education to children of construction workers.
To offer opportunities for these children to succeed in life.
To improve the standard of living for families of construction workers.

benefits.description: Access to medical facilities.
Opportunities for sports and recreational activities.
Provision of a nurturing environment that fosters personal growth.

schemes.eligibility_description: Children destitute during the Corona period, identified by the Women Welfare Department, Lucknow, or children eligible for the Chief Minister Child Service Scheme (General) are eligible. Orphan children and offspring of duly registered construction workers, who have completed at least 01 year (365 days) membership period of the board after registration, are also eligible. A maximum of 02 children per registered worker can avail educational benefits.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the nearest labor office, Tehsildar of the concerned tehsil, or Block Development Officer of the concerned development block.
2. Obtain and completely fill out the application form.

schemes.scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (General)
schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (General) provides support to children under 18 who have lost one or both parents due to non-Covid reasons, and young adults aged 18-23 orphaned by Covid-19 pursuing higher education. It also extends assistance to children of divorced/abandoned mothers, those with imprisoned parents, and children rescued from child labor or begging. The scheme aims to ensure a safe and nurturing environment for these vulnerable children.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to orphaned and vulnerable children for their well-being and development.
To support the higher education of eligible youth, including those excelling in national competitive examinations.
To ensure a safe and nurturing environment for children in need, including those from challenging family circumstances or rescued from exploitation.

benefits.description: ₹2,500/- per month

schemes.eligibility_description: This scheme targets non-institutional children under 18 who lost one or both parents (non-Covid), adolescents aged 18-23 orphaned by Covid-19 pursuing higher education, children of divorced/abandoned mothers, those with imprisoned parents, and children rescued from child labor or begging. It also includes institutional children aged 0-18 previously in children's homes and reintegrated into families or residing in child care institutions. Assistance is provided for a maximum of two children per family, and the family's annual income must be less than ₹3,00,000/-, though this income limit does not apply if both parents have died.
schemes.application_process:
1. For non-institutional children, submit the application form with necessary documents to the Village Development Officer/Gram Panchayat Officer/Block Development Officer (rural areas) or Accountant/Tehsil office/District Probation Officer (urban areas).
2. Applications are verified by the Block Development Officer (rural) or Deputy District Magistrate (urban).
3. Verified applications are forwarded with recommendations to the District Probation Office/Child Protection Unit.
4. For institutional children, the District Child Protection Unit and Child Welfare Committee identify eligible children.
5. Children or their parents must submit applications within 15 days of identification.
6. A district-level task force monitors the Child Welfare Committee and Child Protection Unit to ensure timely application submission.

schemes.scheme_name: Shop Construction/Shop Operation Scheme For Rehabilitation Of PwDs
schemes.description: This scheme supports disabled people in Uttar Pradesh by providing financial assistance to help them start their own shops or businesses. It aims to facilitate the rehabilitation and self-employment of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). The assistance covers both shop construction/purchase and operation.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to eligible Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) in Uttar Pradesh.
To enable PwDs to establish and operate their own shops or businesses.
To promote the rehabilitation and self-employment of disabled individuals.

benefits.description: An amount of Rs. 20,000 is allocated for shop construction or purchase, comprising a Rs. 15,000 loan at 4% interest and a Rs. 5,000 grant.
An amount of Rs. 10,000 is allocated for the operation of a shop, khokha, gumti, or handcart, comprising a Rs. 7,500 loan at 4% interest and a Rs. 2,500 grant.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) with a minimum 40% disability certificate issued by a Chief Medical Officer or Community/Primary Health Centre doctor. They must be citizens of Uttar Pradesh, aged between 18 and 60 years, and not convicted in any criminal or financial matters. Their annual income should not exceed twice the government-prescribed poverty line income limit. For shop construction, they must own or be able to acquire 110 sq. ft. of land, or for shop operation, have a 5-year tenure lease.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Click on the new entry form.
3. Provide personal, bank, income, and disability details.
4. Select the application type.
5. Submit the application.

schemes.scheme_name: Awasiya Vidyala Yojana
schemes.description: This scheme proposes residential schools for children of construction workers who often miss out on education due to their parents' poverty and mobile work sites. It aims to provide quality education and facilities to ensure these children can continue their studies. The scheme will initially operate in specific districts of Uttar Pradesh, with plans for future expansion.
objectives: To provide quality education to children of registered construction workers.
To offer primary, junior high school, and secondary education facilities.
To support children aged 6 to 14 years who are unable to access or continue their schooling.

Free accommodation, clothing, food, and other essential facilities.

schemes.scheme_name: Computer Training Scheme
schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh Computer Training Scheme provides authorized computer courses to eligible unemployed youth. It aims to enhance computer literacy and increase opportunities for candidates across the state. The scheme is implemented by the Backward Classes Welfare Department.

To enhance the education system and increase employment opportunities for youth.
To promote computer literacy among unemployed youth across the state.

benefits.description: Free 'O' Level computer training for 1 month, with fees up to Rs. 15,000 paid to the institution by the government.
Free 'CCC' computer training for 3 months, with fees up to Rs. 3,500 paid to the institution by the government.

2. Register by entering name and mobile number, then verify with OTP.
3. Log in using the received username and password.
4. Fill in required information and upload documents (Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, Intermediate Marks Sheet, photograph).
5. Save and lock the application.
6. Print the application form, attach enclosures, and submit to the office of the District Backward Classes Welfare Officer.

To help children of workers build a better future through education.

For Diploma Courses
For Certificate Courses

To ensure access to education for backward classes in Uttar Pradesh.

Lit, D.S.C.

Empower students to complete secondary school and pursue their educational goals, including higher education.
