Current year fee receipt/admission letter issued by the educational institution

schemes.ministry: Department of Backward Classes Welfare, Uttar Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Sant Ravidaas Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana
schemes.description: The Sant Ravidaas Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana aims to encourage children of registered construction workers in Uttar Pradesh to pursue education. It provides scholarships and incentive funds to meritorious children for higher and professional education. The scheme also offers financial support for various academic levels and additional incentives like bicycle subsidies.
objectives: To encourage children of construction workers registered in the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board towards education.
To provide scholarships and incentive funds to meritorious children of registered construction workers.
To motivate children for higher and professional education, connecting them to the mainstream of education.

benefits.description: Lump sum amounts ranging from ₹2,000 (Class 1-5) to ₹1,00,000 (Research), including ₹12,000 for Undergraduate/ITI/Polytechnic/Vocational, ₹24,000 for Post-graduate, and full fee reimbursement for MBBS/IIM/IIT/NIT/NIFT/Law courses.
Cash awards of ₹5,000 (boys) or ₹8,000 (girls) for passing high school/intermediate with 70%+ marks, and ₹10,000 (boys) or ₹12,000 (girls) for passing graduation/post-graduation with 60%+ marks.
A lump sum subsidy, as prescribed by the Board, for purchasing a bicycle for school commute, provided once after passing Class 9, 10, 11, or 12 and entering the next class.

schemes.eligibility_description: The construction worker must be registered with the Board for at least one year and be actively updated. The child's age must align with their class on July 1st, ranging from 6 to 35 years depending on the educational level. Aadhaar certification of the child is mandatory, and they must be enrolled in a government-recognized educational institution. Benefits are limited to a maximum of two children per registered construction worker.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official web portal.
2. Register by providing Aadhaar Number, Circle, District, and Mobile Number.
3. Choose the scheme, enter Registered Aadhaar and Mobile Number to open the application form.
4. Fill in applicant/worker, child, and bank account details.
5. Submit the required documents.
6. Submit the application request.

documents_required.name: Mark sheets & fee receipts for current and next class
Self-certified copies of mark sheets for grades 1-8 (government schools)
Vouchers/bills countersigned by principal/relevant authority (grades 9-12, degrees/professional courses)
Employment/self-declaration certificate for construction work in past year
Aadhaar certification of the construction worker's children
Additional documents for bicycle benefit (mark sheet, next class fee receipt, school admission/education certificate)
Self-declaration letter confirming no other similar scheme benefits received

schemes.scheme_name: SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship - Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship for financially disadvantaged Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing secondary education in Class 9 or 10. This scheme aims to bridge the financial gap hindering academic progress and empower students from marginalized communities. By providing financial assistance, it encourages students to complete matriculation, opening doors to further educational opportunities.
objectives: Support SC/ST students pursuing secondary education in Class 9 or 10.
Bridge the financial gap that might hinder academic progress for marginalized communities.
Encourage students to complete matriculation and pursue further educational opportunities.

benefits.description: Annual financial assistance of ₹3,500 for day students and ₹7,000 for residential students under Component 1.
Annual financial assistance of ₹3,500 for day students and ₹8,000 for residential students under Component 2.

schemes.eligibility_description: Beneficiaries who are dependents of people in occupations traditionally considered untouchable are eligible. All children of the applicant's parents are eligible. Students cannot receive other scholarships alongside this one, with some exceptions.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and register under the 'Student' option, selecting the appropriate category (SC/ST/General, OBC, Minority, or unclean profession).
2. Select 'Pre-matric (Fresh)' and provide required information to complete registration, noting the registration number.
3. Log in using the registration number, mobile number, and password.
4. Complete DigiLocker verification and fill out the application form including personal and bank details.
5. Upload required documents and complete NPCI verification.
6. Download the application form and submit it to the institute with all required documents.

documents_required.name: Mark sheet of your last qualifying examination

schemes.helpline: Email: support-myscheme@digitalindia.gov.in, Phone: (011) 24303714 (9:00 AM to 5:30 PM)
schemes.ministry: Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department

schemes.scheme_name: Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana
schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana is a government-funded scheme providing financial assistance to construction workers not covered under Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana. It covers treatment costs for various serious illnesses in empanelled government or autonomous hospitals. Benefits are provided to the construction worker's family members.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for serious illnesses to construction workers and their families.
To ensure access to medical treatment for critical diseases not covered by other major health schemes.
To offer full reimbursement of treatment costs and advance payment options for eligible beneficiaries.

benefits.description: Full reimbursement of treatment costs equivalent to the benefit payable under Ayushman Bharat Scheme.
Advance amount can be paid directly to the hospital for medical/surgical treatment after an estimate is provided.

Covers treatment for serious illnesses including heart surgery, kidney/liver/brain transplant, cancer, HIV AIDS, eye/stone/appendix/hydrocele surgery, and diseases under Ayushman Bharat/Mukhya Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana.
No maximum amount is fixed for the financial assistance provided under the scheme.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a registered construction worker under the labor department and not receiving similar benefits from Pradhan Mantri Jan-Arogya Yojana or Chief Minister Jan-Arogya Yojana. Covered family members include self, dependent parents, spouse, daughter, and son (if below 21 years of age).
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the nearest labor office, Tehsildar, or Block Development Officer.
2. Obtain and completely fill out the application form.
3. Attach all required documents in the prescribed format.
4. Submit the completed application form to the same office.

documents_required.name: Bank passbook for account number, branch name and IFSC code
Certificate of being an unmarried daughter or a daughter below 21 years of age

schemes.ministry: Uttar Pradesh Labour Department

schemes.scheme_name: Surgical Grant For The Prevention Of Disability
schemes.description: This scheme provides surgical assistance to poor and helpless disabled persons in Uttar Pradesh. Its main objective is to prevent disability by offering financial grants for various medical treatments. The scheme covers surgeries for visually, hearing, and orthopedically handicapped individuals, as well as those with post-leprosy-cured disabilities.
objectives: To provide surgical assistance for the prevention of disability.
To support poor and helpless disabled persons in Uttar Pradesh.
To cover a wide range of surgeries including those for visual, hearing, orthopedic impairments, and post-leprosy-cured conditions.

benefits.description: A maximum of Rs. 6,00,000/- will be provided to each disabled person for surgical assistance.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be an Indian citizen, a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh or a resident for at least 5 years, and should not be guilty in any criminal case.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download the application form from page no. 18.
2. Fill out the application form completely.
3. Attach all required documents.
4. Submit the application to the District Disabled Welfare Officer.
5. The District Disabled Welfare Officer will forward the application with recommendation to the Director.
6. In case of emergency, applications can be sent directly to the Director.

documents_required.name: Income Proof (Certificate of annual income from all sources)
Certificate of disability granted by a competent medical authority
Estimated expenditure details of the surgery by the superintendent/in charge of the State Hospital

schemes.scheme_name: Berojgari Bhatta Yojna
schemes.description: The Berojgari Bhatta Yojna provides financial assistance to educated unemployed youth in Uttar Pradesh. It aims to support individuals who are searching for employment but face financial difficulties. The scheme also offers a portal for job search and online application facilities.
objectives: To provide financial assistance in the form of unemployment allowance to educated youth.
To support state residents who are actively searching for employment.
To help talented individuals overcome financial crises preventing them from applying for jobs.

benefits.description: Monthly unemployment allowance ranging from Rupees 1,000 to Rupees 1,500 until the youth secures a desired job.
Access to a unified online portal listing both private and government job opportunities.
Facilitates online application for the scheme and job searches.
Provides advanced search filters for jobs by category, location, department, and salary.

schemes.eligibility_description: Candidates must have passed at least the 10th standard (High School) examinations and must be currently unemployed, not working in any private or government job.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website.
2. Click the “New Account” link and fill out the registration form.
3. Log in to complete the UP Berojgari Bhatta Yojana Online Application Form and profile.
4. Submit the application for approval by the concerned authorities.

documents_required.name: Proof of educational qualification (mark sheets, certificates, etc.)

schemes.scheme_name: Artificial Limbs/Assistive Equipments Scheme
schemes.description: This scheme provides financial grants to persons with disabilities in Uttar Pradesh for purchasing artificial limbs and auxiliary equipment. It targets individuals or families whose annual income is below the state-defined BPL limits. The scheme aims to empower persons with disabilities by providing essential mobility, educational, and daily activity aids.
objectives: To provide financial grants to persons with disabilities to buy artificial limbs and auxiliary equipment.
To ensure access to essential equipment such as tricycles, wheelchairs, Braille kits, and hearing aids based on disability.
To support persons with multi-disabilities with a higher financial grant for multiple assistance/aid equipment.

benefits.description: Maximum financial grant of Rs. 8,000 for the purchase of artificial limbs and auxiliary equipment for persons with disabilities.
Maximum financial grant of Rs. 10,000 in one go for persons with multi-disability or those needing more than one assistance/aid equipment.

Provision of various assistive equipment including mobility aids (tricycles, wheelchairs, crutches), educational equipment (Braille kits, abacus), hearing aids, M.S.I.D. kits for mental disabilities, and daily activity kits for people free from leprosy.

eligibility.disability: Minimum 40% disability, certified by Competent Authority of State Government. Medical Officer recommendation for artificial limbs/accessories is required.

schemes.eligibility_description: Any person with a disability of any age who is a resident of Uttar Pradesh. The annual income of the applicant or their family must be within the poverty line definition (currently Rs. 46,080/- for rural areas and Rs. 56,460/- per family per year for urban areas). Applicants should not have benefited from similar government schemes in the last three years (one year for regular students).
schemes.application_process:
1. Apply through the Office of the PWD Empowerment Officer, Jan Suvidha Kendra, or Lokvani Kendra.
2. Obtain or download the application form.
3. Fill out the form in the prescribed manner.
4. Attach all required documents.
5. Submit the application form to the concerned officer.
6. Financial grants are approved on a 'First Come and First Serve Basis' by the District PWD Empowerment Officer.

documents_required.name: Caste Certificate (if belonging to Scheduled Castes / Backward Classes)

schemes.scheme_name: Marriage Grant Scheme
schemes.description: The Marriage Grant Scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of daughters from poor families belonging to Other Backward Classes in Uttar Pradesh. It aims to improve the economic condition of these families by supporting the marriage expenses of their daughters. The scheme targets helpless, poor, and BPL families.
objectives: To provide grants for the marriage of daughters from poor families of Other Backward Classes.
To improve the economic condition of beneficiary families.
To uplift the living standards of poor families through welfare efforts by the Department of Backward Classes Welfare.

benefits.description: An assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided per marriage.

schemes.eligibility_description: The scheme is for daughters of poor individuals from Other Backward Classes. The applicant's annual income should not exceed Rs. 56,460/- in urban areas and Rs. 46,080/- in rural areas. The girl must be 18 years or older, and the boy 21 years or older. Priority is given to destitute women or widow applicants, who are exempt from needing a caste certificate. A maximum of 02 daughters per family can receive benefits.
schemes.application_process:
1. Applicants must apply online through Jan Suvidha Kendras, District Backward Classes Welfare Officer, or the department's official website.
2. The online application must be submitted within 90 days prior to the marriage date or up to 90 days after the marriage has been conducted.
3. Applicants must retain a hard copy of the online application along with all self-attested uploaded documents for record.

documents_required.name: Marriage Invitation Card (or certificate showing date fixed for marriage)
Documentary proof (in case of widow/PwD certificate)

schemes.ministry: Department of Backward Classes Welfare

schemes.scheme_name: Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme
schemes.description: The Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme, sponsored by the Government of Uttar Pradesh, provides financial incentives to Divyangjan (differently-abled persons) who get married. The scheme aims to encourage marriage among differently-abled individuals by offering monetary rewards. To be eligible, the marriage must be registered, and at least one spouse must have a minimum 40% disability.
objectives: To provide financial incentives for marriage to Divyangjan in Uttar Pradesh.
To promote social inclusion and empowerment of differently-abled individuals.
To encourage registered marriages among the disabled population within the state.

benefits.description: ₹15,000/- is provided if the young man has a disability.
₹20,000/- is provided if the girl has a disability.

benefits.type: Financial assistance for both spouses with disability
benefits.description: ₹35,000/- is provided if both the young man and girl have disabilities.

schemes.eligibility_description: The couple must be permanent residents or domiciled in Uttar Pradesh for at least five years. Neither member should have a criminal conviction or be an income taxpayer. The marriage must be registered, and at least one spouse must have a minimum 40% disability certificate.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Click on the registration link.
3. Fill out the application form with details such as disability type/percentage, couple's names, present address, and marriage registration certificate.
4. Submit the online application form.
5. Submit a hard copy of the online application form to the District Disabled Empowerment Office of your district within 15 days.

schemes.scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension Scheme
schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension Scheme provides financial assistance to senior citizens from economically weaker sections. Under this scheme, the government directly transfers a monthly pension amount to the beneficiaries' bank accounts.
objectives: To provide financial support to elderly citizens in Uttar Pradesh.
To improve the living standards of senior citizens from economically weaker sections.
To ensure direct benefit transfer of pension amounts to eligible beneficiaries.

benefits.description: Monthly pension amount

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be below the poverty line or have an annual income up to Rs. 46,080 for rural areas and Rs. 56,460 for urban areas. Not eligible if already benefiting from other pension schemes.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website.
2. Select the option "Old Age Pension" and then "Apply Online".
3. Fill out the application form and provide the required information.
4. Upload required documents such as photograph and age certificate.
5. Submit the application.

schemes.scheme_name: Widow Pension - Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has implemented the Widow Pension Scheme to provide financial assistance to widows living within the state. Administered by the Women Welfare Department, this initiative offers a monthly pension to help vulnerable women navigate hardships. It aims to empower widows, enabling them to rebuild their lives with dignity and secure financial stability.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to widows in Uttar Pradesh.
Empower widowed women to achieve financial security and stability.
Support vulnerable women in rebuilding their lives with dignity after losing a spouse.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance provided to eligible widows.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant's husband must have died. The applicant should not be receiving pension from any other scheme of the state or central government.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and click 'Apply Online'.
2. Provide personal, bank, and income details.
3. Upload a passport size color photograph, birth/age certificate, husband's death certificate, and a declaration.
4. Click on submit to complete the application.

documents_required.name: Photocopy of bank account with IFS code
Affidavit stating not receiving pension from any other scheme

schemes.ministry: Women Welfare Department

schemes.scheme_name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme- Differently-abled and Posthumously
schemes.description: The Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme, launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttar Pradesh, honors outstanding sportspersons. It recognizes both male (Laxman Award) and female (Rani Laxmi Bai Award) athletes across 31 sports disciplines. The scheme also extends recognition to differently-abled players and posthumous recipients for their significant achievements.
objectives: To recognize and honor outstanding sportspersons from Uttar Pradesh for their achievements.
To encourage excellence in sports by providing prestigious awards to male and female athletes across 31 disciplines.
To ensure inclusivity by extending recognition to differently-abled players and posthumous recipients.

benefits.description: A cash prize of ₹3,11,000/-
A Citation, a Bronze statue of either Laxman or Rani Laxmi Bai, and a Scroll

schemes.eligibility_description: The player must be a bonafide native of Uttar Pradesh and a sportsperson who has participated in National Games/Championships for specific years and earned medals. Applicants must not have been found guilty of drug abuse, court suits, or sexual harassment. For the Veteran category, players must be 40 years of age or above on April 1 of the application year.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the prescribed application form.
2. Fill in all mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph, and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the respective sports officer of the concerned district.
4. Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority.

documents_required.name: Affidavit (not found guilty of substance abuse)

schemes.ministry: Department of Sports

schemes.scheme_name: Shauchalaya Sahayata Yojana
schemes.description: The Shauchalaya Sahayata Yojana is a Uttar Pradesh government scheme providing financial assistance to registered construction workers. It aims to help them build toilets in their homes, contributing to the state's goal of eradicating open defecation. Launched in 2017, it is part of the national Swachh Bharat Mission.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for toilet construction.
Empower underprivileged construction workers to build toilets at home.
Contribute to Uttar Pradesh's goal of eradicating open defecation.

benefits.description: A grant of ₹12,000/- for toilet construction, paid in two installments: ₹6,000/- before construction and ₹6,000/- after completion and use.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, own a home without a toilet, not have received similar benefits from other government schemes, and regularly deposit contributions. An Aadhaar card and a bank account in a CBS branch of a nationalized bank are required.
schemes.application_process:
1. District Panchayat Raj Officer provides a list of registered construction workers.
2. Village Panchayat Secretary/Sanitation worker verifies the list and identifies toilet-less workers.
3. Obtain the application form from the nearest labor office, Tehsildar, Block Development Officer, or download it.
4. Fill out the application form completely and attach required documents.
5. Submit the application form to the same office where it was obtained.

documents_required.name: Copy of construction worker registration card
Copy of bank passbook for account number, branch name and IFSC code
Declaration of not getting the benefit of toilet construction facility from any other scheme
Declaration that family doesn't have a permanent house

schemes.ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh

schemes.scheme_name: Matritva, Shishu Evam Baalika Madad Yojana
schemes.description: The Matritva, Shishu Evam Baalika Madad Yojana is a scheme by the Uttar Pradesh government providing financial assistance to construction worker women and wives of construction workers during pregnancy and childbirth. It aims to ensure safe and healthy pregnancies and deliveries. The scheme also promotes positive societal views towards the birth of girls and encourages legal adult marriage.
objectives: Ensure safe and healthy pregnancies and deliveries for women.
Provide nutritious food to newborn babies of eligible beneficiaries from birth until 2 years of age.
Create positive thinking in society towards the birth of girls and encourage legal adult marriage.

benefits.description: Financial assistance for registered construction workers during pregnancy, childbirth, miscarriage, or sterilization, including lump sums, minimum wage equivalents, and medical bonuses.
Financial support for the birth of children, including lump sums for sons and daughters, and fixed deposits for daughters (first/second, adopted, or handicapped) maturing at 18 if unmarried.

schemes.eligibility_description: Beneficiary women must be permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh, registered construction workers, and above 18 years of age. Benefits are limited to the first two deliveries. For child benefits, specific conditions apply regarding the number and order of girl children, legal adoption, and birth registration. Beneficiaries should not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the nearest labor office, Tehsildar of the concerned tehsil, or Block Development Officer of the concerned development block.
2. Obtain and completely fill out the application form.
3. Attach all required documents in the prescribed format.
4. Submit the completed application form to the same office.

documents_required.name: Anganwadi registration certificate (for girl child support)

schemes.scheme_name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
schemes.description: The Kanyashree Prakalpa scheme, launched by the Department of Women Development and Social Welfare and Child Development, Government of West Bengal, aims to improve the status and well-being of girls from socio-economically disadvantaged families. It provides Conditional Cash Transfers to incentivize girls to continue their education and disincentivize early marriage. The scheme also focuses on financial inclusion and empowerment through direct bank transfers and a behaviour change communication strategy.
objectives: Incentivising girls to continue in education for a longer period, completing secondary, higher secondary, higher education, or equivalent in technical, vocational, or sports streams.
Disincentivising marriage until at least the age of 18, thereby reducing risks of early pregnancies, maternal and child mortality, and other health conditions.
Conferring more than just monetary support, serving as a means of financial inclusion and a tool of empowerment for adolescent girls.

benefits.description: An annual cash benefit of ₹1,000/- is paid to girls aged 13 to 18 years (studying in Class VIII or above) for every year they remain in education, provided they are unmarried.
A one-time grant of ₹25,000/- is paid after a girl turns 18, provided she was engaged in an academic or occupational pursuit and was unmarried.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, enrolled and regularly attending an educational institution registered in West Bengal, and unmarried. Family income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/- per year, with relaxations for specially-abled girls (40% or more disability), those living in a Home registered under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2000, or girls who have lost both parents. Applicants for Annual Scholarship (K1) must be 13-18 years, and for One-Time Grant (K2) must be 18-19 years. A bank account in the applicant's name is mandatory.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the appropriate application form (K1 for Annual Scholarship, K2 for One-Time Grant) from your educational institution.
2. Open a bank account in your own name, ensuring the name matches the application form.
3. Fill out the application form completely, ensuring correct spelling of your name and mobile number.
4. Submit photocopies of all required documents to your institution.
5. Collect the acknowledgement receipt from the Head Teacher, which contains your Form No.
6. Track your application status on the Kanyashree Portal using the Form No. from your acknowledgement slip.

documents_required.name: Juvenile Justice Act Home Residence Proof

schemes.ministry: Department of Women Development and Social Welfare and Child Development (DWD), Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme: Facilitation Supports
schemes.description: This sub-scheme, launched by the Government of West Bengal, provides various facilitation supports to artisans and Industrial Cooperative Societies. It aims to assist them with formalization, compliance, and development within the state. The scheme is part of the broader West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024 and will be in force for five years.
objectives: To provide various types of facilitation support to individual artisans.
To assist in the formation and compliance of Industrial Cooperative Societies.
To promote the formalization and development of traditional crafts and trades in West Bengal.

benefits.description: Facilitation for artisans to enlist on the State Portal for Artisans.
Facilitation for the formation of Industrial Cooperative Societies.
Facilitation for obtaining necessary statutory requirements for artisans and societies.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be Indian citizens and permanent residents of West Bengal for the past 10 years, aged between 18 and 60 years. They should belong to an artisan group, engaged in traditional crafts/trades using hand tools/equipment/small machines, and be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers. Exclusions include central/state government employees and their family members, those who have already received similar assistance, and handloom/Khadi weavers.
schemes.application_process:
1. Prepare the application as an individual artisan or an Industrial Cooperative Society.
2. Submit the application at the relevant local office: BDO’s office for rural areas, SDO’s office for Municipality areas, or the Municipal Corporation Office for urban areas.

documents_required.name: Proof of enrolment in the State portal for artisans & weavers

schemes.ministry: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society
schemes.description: "Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society" is a sub-scheme under the West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024, launched by the Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department. It aims to provide systematic financial support for tools, equipment, worksheds, and other fixed assets. The scheme targets groups of at least 10 artisans organized under an industrial cooperative society in West Bengal.
objectives: To provide systematic financial support to groups of artisans.
To facilitate the procurement of essential tools, equipment, and fixed assets for artisan cooperative societies.
To support the construction or establishment of worksheds for industrial cooperative societies.

benefits.description: For tools and equipment
For Work Shed construction and other fixed assets

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant should belong to any group of artisans, be engaged in traditional craft/trade with hand tools/equipment/small machines, be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers, and be an Indian citizen permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years. For Work shed, an industrial cooperative society of eligible artisans should possess a piece of land.
schemes.application_process:
1. Applications by individual artisans or Cooperative Societies are submitted offline.
2. For rural areas, applications are submitted at the BDO’s office.
3. For Municipality areas, applications are submitted at the SDO’s office.
4. For urban areas, applications are submitted at the Municipal Corporation Office.

documents_required.name: Proof of enrolment in the State portal for artisans & weavers
Standard price of tools/kits on the basis of 3 sets of quotations collected
Land documents where Work Shed to be constructed
Project estimate with lay out drawings vetted by a competent authority (SAE/EE)
Registration certificate in case of the industrial cooperative society

schemes.ministry: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme
schemes.description: This scheme provides financial support to students for pursuing secondary, higher secondary, undergraduate, and postgraduate studies, including professional degrees, within and outside India. It also covers students enrolled in coaching institutions for competitive examinations. The scheme aims to ensure that no student is deprived of education due to financial constraints.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to students for pursuing various levels of education, including professional courses.
To enable students to access higher education both within and outside India.
To support students preparing for competitive examinations through coaching institutions.

benefits.description: Maximum loan of ₹10,00,000/- available at a 4% simple annual interest rate after interest subvention.
No collateral security is required, only co-obligation of parents/legal guardians.
Nil margin money for loans up to ₹4,00,000/-, and 5% for loans above ₹4,00,000/-.
Life cover for the student up to the loan amount, with premium debited from the loan account.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be an Indian citizen and a resident of West Bengal for at least 10 years (self-declaration). The applicant should be enrolled in higher education programs or coaching institutes for competitive exams within or outside the country.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and click on "STUDENT CREDIT CARD".
2. Click on "STUDENT REGISTRATION" and select the appropriate option (for institutions in India or outside).
3. Provide required details for online registration to generate user ID and password.
4. Log in using the generated credentials via the "Student Login" button.
5. Furnish personal, co-borrower, address, course, income, and bank details through the "Applicant Dashboard".
6. Upload all necessary documents and submit the application.

documents_required.name: Colored Photograph of the co-applicant / co-borrower

schemes.ministry: Higher Education Department and School Education Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery
schemes.description: This welfare scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, West Bengal, provides financial assistance for medical expenses. It targets registered building and construction workers and their dependents. The scheme covers treatment for major ailments including surgery like Cancer, Heart disease, Kidney disease, T.B., Eye disease, Leprosy, and Nerve disease.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for medical expenses to registered construction workers.
To support the treatment of major ailments and surgeries for beneficiaries and their dependents.
To improve the health and well-being of the construction worker community in West Bengal.

benefits.description: Maximum financial assistance for medical expenses per annum.
Maximum financial assistance for operations of diseases like Heart, Kidney.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, a Building/Construction Worker aged 18-60, and have worked at least 90 days in a year for registration. For the welfare scheme, the applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and the member or their dependents must suffer from specified major ailments.
schemes.application_process:
1. For Registration: Request Form-27 from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
2. Submit Form-27 with mandatory documents to the respective officers.
3. For Welfare Scheme: Request Form-XI from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
4. Submit Form-XI with mandatory documents to the respective officers for benefit.

documents_required.name: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)
schemes.description: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY) is a housing scheme launched by the Ministry of Rural Development, GOI, in FY 2016-17. It aims to provide a pucca house (minimum 25 sq mt floor area) to houseless households and those residing in kutcha or dilapidated houses in West Bengal. The scheme offers financial assistance, wage support, and aid for toilet construction.
objectives: To provide a pucca house to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
To offer financial assistance for house construction, distributed in three installments.
To support beneficiaries with wages for unskilled labor and assistance for constructing toilets.

benefits.description: Beneficiaries receive ₹1,30,000/- per house, credited in three installments (₹60,000, ₹60,000, ₹10,000).
Beneficiaries are entitled to 95 unskilled mandays of wages under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS).
Eligible beneficiaries receive additional support for constructing toilets under 'Mission Nirmal Bangla Prakalpa'.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be an Indian citizen, enlisted in the Permanent Waiting List (PWL) based on SECC 2011 data, and from a houseless household or living in a kutcha or dilapidated house.
schemes.application_process:
1. Check the Permanent Waiting List (PWL) on the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) website.
2. Select the concerned District, Block, Panchayat name and verify the captcha to check the list.
3. Beneficiaries whose names are already enlisted in the PWL do not need to submit any additional application.
4. The government sanctions houses every financial year based on the priority list and category-wise allocation.
5. Eligible beneficiaries will be informed about the sanctioning process and receive financial assistance directly in their registered bank accounts.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), GOI

schemes.scheme_name: Pratyasha Scheme- West Bengal
schemes.description: The Pratyasha Scheme is a housing project by the Government of West Bengal for Police Personnel (Inspectors to Constables) to help them own houses. The West Bengal State Police Housing Corporation constructs various types of flats with financial assistance from HUDCO. Police personnel can apply for housing assistance under this scheme.
objectives: To provide housing solutions to Police Personnel in West Bengal.
To construct various types of flats tailored to different ranks and pay scales.
To facilitate home ownership dreams for eligible police personnel through financial assistance and structured allotment.

benefits.description: Construction and allotment of various types of flats for eligible Police Personnel of West Bengal.

schemes.eligibility_description: Any Police personnel in the ranks of Deputy Superintendent (Non-WBPS)/ Assistant Commissioner, Inspector, Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant, Assistant Sub-Inspector, Constable, and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police are eligible. Specific pay thresholds (₹18,000+, ₹15,000+, ₹8,840+) determine eligibility for different flat categories (A, B, C). Only one application per personnel is allowed, and joint applications are restricted to immediate family members where the first applicant is an eligible police personnel.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download the application form, Information Guide, and General Terms & Conditions from the West Bengal Police or Kolkata Police websites.
2. Obtain an A/C Payee Demand Draft/Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque for the application money, payable to "Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited" at Kolkata.
3. Write applicant's Name, Father’s/Husband’s Name, and Telephone No. on the reverse of the payment instrument.
4. Fill the application form completely, sign it, and attach the payment instrument and other required documents.
5. Submit the application either in person at the office of West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), Block-DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700 091, or send it by post to the same address.

documents_required.name: Demand Draft/ Pay Order/ Banker’s Cheque for application money
Self-attested photocopy of PAN Card (applicant and joint applicants)
Two passport-size photographs with signature on back
Copy of first page of Bank A/C Pass Book
Demand Draft/ Pay Order/ Banker’s Cheque for parking space (if applicable)

schemes.ministry: Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Banglar Yuba Sathi
schemes.description: The Banglar Yuba Sathi scheme, implemented by the Department of Youth Services & Sports, Government of West Bengal, aims to support educated unemployed youth. It provides a monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500/- through direct bank transfer. The assistance is available for up to 5 years or until the beneficiary secures employment or enrolls in another scheme.
objectives: To provide financial support to educated unemployed youth in West Bengal.
To assist beneficiaries until they secure employment or join other welfare schemes.
To promote youth welfare by offering a monthly allowance.

benefits.description: Monthly allowance of ₹1,500/- disbursed via Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) to an AADHAR-linked bank account. The benefit is valid for up to 5 years or until employment/enrollment in another scheme, whichever is earlier.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal, aged between 21 and 40 years as on 01.04.2026, and unemployed. They must have passed the Madhyamik or equivalent examination. Beneficiaries are subject to yearly verification of their live status, and financial assistance may be stopped if eligibility conditions are no longer met or if sanctioned on mistaken grounds. Applicants must not be covered under any other social security scheme or receiving other State Government allowances (except scholarship/educational benefits).
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website and click on the 'Click to Apply' icon.
2. Enter a valid mobile number and captcha; then log in using the received OTP/PIN.
3. Complete and submit the online application form with all necessary details.
4. Upload all mandatory supporting documents as per the prescribed list.
5. Click 'Final Submit' to complete the application.
6. Download and retain the submitted application form for future reference.

documents_required.name: First page of bank passbook / Cancelled cheque

schemes.ministry: Department of Youth Services & Sports, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Tool Purchase Grant for the Construction Workers
schemes.description: This is a welfare scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal. It provides a one-time reimbursement to registered construction workers for purchasing tools related to their profession. The scheme aims to support the professional needs of eligible beneficiaries.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for the purchase of essential tools.
To support the professional development and welfare of building and other construction workers.
To facilitate the acquisition of necessary equipment for workers registered with the BOCW Welfare Board.

benefits.description: One-time reimbursement of ₹2,000/- for purchasing tools related to the beneficiary's profession.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, a Building/Construction Worker aged between 18 and 60 years, and have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. Additionally, the applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal for at least 6 months, and purchased tools must relate to their profession.
schemes.application_process:
1. Request Form-27 for worker registration from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
2. Submit Form-27 along with mandatory documents for registration as a Building/Construction Worker.
3. Upon successful verification, the worker is registered, and an identity card and passbook are issued.
4. Request the application form for the welfare scheme from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
5. Attach the member's Identity Card and the original bill/voucher of the purchased tools.
6. Submit the completed application for the benefit to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.

documents_required.name: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age
Original bill/voucher of the purchased tools

schemes.scheme_name: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana
schemes.description: The Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana (BM-SSY) is a social security scheme for unorganized workers in West Bengal. It aims to improve the lives of millions of workers and their families by providing various financial and welfare benefits. The scheme covers a wide range of unorganized workers, including construction, transport, and self-employed individuals.
objectives: To provide social security to unorganized workers and their families in West Bengal.
To offer financial assistance for health, education, and provident fund needs.
To provide compensation in cases of death or disability of the beneficiary.

benefits.description: State government contributes ₹55 per month to a provident fund, which is refunded with interest on retirement or death.

Financial assistance for hospitalization (up to ₹20,000 annually) and surgery (up to ₹60,000 annually) for beneficiaries and family members, including compensation for loss of employment during hospitalization.
Compensation for accidental death (₹2,00,000), normal death (₹50,000), total disability (₹2,00,000), and partial disability (₹1,00,000).

Annual financial assistance for education from Class XI to Medical/Engineering courses (₹4,000 - ₹30,000), and ₹25,000 each for up to two unmarried daughters completing UG or equivalent skill development.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of West Bengal, aged 18-60 years, and belong to the unorganized sector. Family income should not exceed ₹6,500 per month, with no upper limit for construction and transport workers.
schemes.application_process:
1. Visit the official website https://bmssy.wblabour.gov.in/.
2. Click on “New Registration by Beneficiary” and complete the registration with personal and contact details.
3. Log in using the received Username and Password.
4. Provide required details including Basic Information, Address, Bank, Nominee, and Dependent details.
5. Upload all necessary documents.
6. Download and upload Form-1 (from page 12 of manual documents), then submit the application.

schemes.scheme_name: Accidental Benefit
schemes.description: The Accidental Benefit scheme by the West Bengal Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance to registered construction workers. It covers hospitalization for accidents, disablement, and offers monthly pensions for permanent disability or to their spouse/nominee in case of death. The scheme aims to support workers and their families during unforeseen circumstances.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for hospitalization due to accidents.
To offer financial support and a monthly pension to workers who become disabled due to an accident.
To ensure financial security for the families of permanently disabled pension holders through a family pension.

benefits.description: Financial assistance for hospitalization of 5 or more days due to an accident.
Financial assistance for disablement due to an accident.
Monthly pension for permanent disablement.
Monthly family pension for spouse/nominee in case of death of a permanent disablement pension holder.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, a Building/Construction Worker aged 18-60 years, and engaged in construction work for at least 90 days in a given year for registration. For the welfare scheme, the applicant must be a registered member of the BOCW Welfare Board and have been hospitalized for 5+ days or become disabled/permanently disabled due to an accident.
schemes.application_process: 1. For registration, request Form-27 from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers. 2. Attach mandatory documents (self-attested if required) to Form-27. 3. Submit the registration application to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers. 4. For the welfare scheme, request Form-XXXIV from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers. 5. Attach mandatory documents (self-attested if required) to Form-XXXIV. 6. Submit the welfare scheme application to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.

documents_required.name: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age
Dependent/ Heirship Certificate of the applicant

schemes.scheme_name: Disability Pension - West Bengal
schemes.description: The West Bengal Disability Pension Scheme 2010 provides financial assistance to persons with disabilities who are unable to work and earn a living. It targets disabled individuals with at least 40% disability, declared unsuitable for physical work by a medical officer, and with a low family income. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to disabled persons in West Bengal.
To support individuals with at least 40% disability who are unable to work.
To ensure social welfare for vulnerable disabled residents of the state.

benefits.description: Provides financial assistance to persons with disabilities who are unable to work and earn a living.

eligibility.disability: Applicant must have at least 40% disability and be declared unsuitable for physical work by a Medical officer due to specific disabilities (Deaf and Dumb, Blind, Orthopedically handicapped, Mentally retarded, Permanently incapacitated).

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Bengal, or have resided in West Bengal for at least 10 years (or since birth for those under 10). Family income must not exceed ₹1,000 per month. Individuals receiving other pensions (Widow, Old Age, Farmers', Family Pension) or professional beggars are excluded.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the Application Form (Form-P) free of cost from the Block Development Officer, Executive Officer of the concerned Panchayat Samity, Sub-Divisional Officer, or Controller of Vagrancy, West Bengal, based on the applicant's residential area.
2. Fill out the application form with personal, contact, disability details, and bank account information.
3. Attach all required self-attested documents.
4. Submit the completed application form to the District Magistrate (via BDO/Executive Officer/SDO) or Controller of Vagrancy, West Bengal, as per the residential jurisdiction.
schemes.ministry: Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
schemes.description: The Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme, launched by the West Bengal Government in February 2021, provides monthly financial assistance to women aged 25-60 years from economically weaker sections. It aims to empower women by offering ₹1,200/- to SC/ST households and ₹1,000/- to other beneficiaries. The scheme targets women enrolled in 'Swasthya Sathi' to promote financial independence.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to women from economically weaker sections of society.
To empower women and make them financially independent.
To support women in the age group of 25-60 years who are enrolled in ‘Swasthya Sathi’.

benefits.description: For women from Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes households.
For women from other categories.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, a woman aged 25-60 years, and her household must be enrolled under the 'Swasthyasathi' scheme. She should not be a permanent or retired government employee receiving regular salary/pension from Central/State Government or related bodies.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the free application form at Duare Sarkar Camps.
2. Submit the filled and signed application form with self-attested copies of required documents at a Duare Sarkar Camp.
3. Government officials will inquire into applications as per Duare Sarkar modalities.
4. Block Development Officer/Sub-Divisional Officer (or Commissioner, KMC) will enter, verify, and recommend eligible applicants to the District Magistrate for sanction.
5. The District Magistrate (or Commissioner, KMC for Kolkata) will be the sanctioning authority.
6. Financial assistance will be credited monthly via DBT to the Aadhaar-linked, single bank account of the eligible female member.

documents_required.name: Bank Account Details (photocopy of bank book page)
Self-declaration of not being a government employee/pensioner

schemes.scheme_name: Manabik Scheme
schemes.description: The Manabik Scheme, launched by the Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal, provides financial support to individuals with disabilities. It aims to assist those unable to work due to their disability in maintaining a reasonable standard of living.
objectives: Provide financial support to individuals who are unable to work due to a disability.
Assist individuals in maintaining a reasonable standard of living.
Empower differently abled persons by offering a stable income source.

benefits.description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 disbursed via DBT to the pensioner's bank account.

eligibility.disability: Minimum 50% disability and declared unsuitable for physical work by a Medical Officer.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal for at least 10 years, have a minimum 50% disability, be declared unsuitable for physical work by a medical officer, and have a family income not exceeding ₹1,00,000 per month.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the application form free of cost from the Office of the Block Development Officer (rural areas), Sub-Divisional Officer (municipal areas), or Controller of Vagrancy (Kolkata Municipal Corporation areas).
2. Fill out the application form with all required details.
3. Submit the completed form along with self-attested copies of all necessary documents.
4. Applications can be submitted at Duare Sarkar Camps, BDO office (rural), SDO office (urban), or Controller of Vagrancy office (KMC area).

documents_required.name: Copy of front page of Bank Pass Book

schemes.ministry: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Maternity Benefit
schemes.description: The Maternity Benefit scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, West Bengal, provides financial assistance to registered female workers or wives of male beneficiaries during maternity. This welfare scheme aims to support the well-being of construction workers' families. The benefit can be availed a maximum of two times in a beneficiary's lifetime.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to registered construction workers during the period of maternity.
To support the well-being and financial security of female construction workers and their families.
To ensure registered beneficiaries receive aid for maternity-related expenses.

benefits.description: Financial benefit of ₹6,000/- provided during maternity, available up to two times in a beneficiary's lifetime.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, a registered female member or wife of a male member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and pregnant. For registration, the applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker aged 18-60 years, engaged in construction work for at least 90 days in a given year, and registered for 1 year under the Board.
schemes.application_process:
1. Request Form-27 (for registration) or Form-XII (for welfare scheme) from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
2. Attach all mandatory self-attested documents.
3. Submit the completed application to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
4. For registration, pay a ₹20 registration fee and ₹30 yearly subscription; an identity card and passbook will be issued upon verification.
5. Renew the yearly subscription by paying ₹30 and submitting Form-27A after one year.
6. Failure to renew will result in cancellation of registration.

documents_required.name: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation
schemes.description: The West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation is a social welfare initiative launched by the Labour Department, Government of West Bengal. It provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 to the nominee of a registered migrant worker who dies at their workplace or place of stay for work. The scheme aims to support the families of deceased migrant workers by covering cremation expenses.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for the cremation of registered migrant workers.
To support the nominees and families of migrant workers who die during employment.
To enhance the social welfare provisions for migrant workers from West Bengal.

benefits.description: Financial assistance for cremation of a registered migrant worker.

schemes.eligibility_description: To register as a Migrant Worker, the applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, aged between 18-60 years, and employed or likely to be employed outside West Bengal or India. For the welfare scheme application, the beneficiary must be a nominee of a registered migrant worker who died during the course of employment at their workplace or place of stay for the job.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download and install the “KARMASATHI (PARIJAYEE SHRAMIK )” mobile application.
2. Register as a Migrant Worker by providing mobile number, basic, address, and employment details.
3. Complete registration by adding bank, ration card, nominee details, and uploading mandatory documents to get a permanent MWIN.
4. Login to the app using OTP.
5. Navigate to the “Services” menu to apply for welfare assistance.
6. Provide claim details, upload required documents, and submit the application.

documents_required.name: First page of bank account particulars

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance
schemes.description: This social welfare scheme provides financial assistance to the nominee of a registered migrant worker from West Bengal. Assistance is given in cases of natural or accidental death of the worker. It aims to support the families of migrant workers.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to the nominee of a registered migrant worker in case of natural death.
Provide financial assistance to the nominee of a registered migrant worker in case of accidental death.
Ensure welfare and support for migrant workers and their families from West Bengal.

benefits.description: For natural death of the registered migrant worker.
For accidental death of the registered migrant worker.

schemes.eligibility_description: To register as a Migrant Worker, the applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, aged 18-60 years, and employed or likely to be employed outside West Bengal or India. For the welfare scheme application, the beneficiary must be a nominee (family member) of a registered migrant worker who has died due to natural or accidental causes.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download and install the “KARMASATHI (PARIJAYEE SHRAMIK )” APP.
2. Register as a Migrant Worker by providing mobile number, basic, address, and employment details.
3. Complete registration by providing bank accounts, ration card, nominee details, and uploading mandatory documents to get a permanent MWIN.
4. For welfare assistance, open the app, login, and tap the “Services” menu.
5. Provide claim details and upload respective documents for the concerned scheme.
6. Submit the application to complete the process.

documents_required.name: First page of bank account particulars

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body
schemes.description: This scheme provides financial assistance to the nominee of a registered migrant worker from West Bengal who dies during employment outside the state. It aims to help cover the costs of repatriating the deceased worker's body to their permanent address. The scheme is implemented by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board.
objectives: Provide financial assistance for the repatriation of deceased migrant workers' bodies.
Support the families of West Bengal migrant workers who die while employed outside the state.
Ensure dignified return of deceased migrant workers to their permanent address in West Bengal.

benefits.description: Financial assistance of ₹ 25,000/- to the nominee of the registered Migrant Worker for repatriation of the dead body.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal, aged between 18-60 years, and ordinarily employed or likely to be employed outside West Bengal or India. The beneficiary must be a nominee of a registered migrant worker who died during the course of employment outside the State of West Bengal.
schemes.application_process:
1. Download and install the “KARMASATHI (PARIJAYEE SHRAMIK )” APP from Google Play Store.
2. Register as a Migrant Worker by providing mobile number, basic, address, employment, bank, ration card, and nominee details.
3. Upload mandatory documents to complete registration and obtain a permanent MWIN.
4. Open the APP and login using OTP.
5. Navigate to the “Services” menu to apply for welfare assistance.
6. Provide claim details, upload respective documents, and submit the application.

documents_required.name: Aadhar card (both sides in a single page)
First page of bank account particulars

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Miscarriage Benefit
schemes.description: The Miscarriage Benefit scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, West Bengal, provides financial assistance to registered female workers or wives of male beneficiaries. It aims to support those who experience a miscarriage. The benefit is available up to two times in a beneficiary's lifetime.
objectives: To provide financial support to registered construction workers experiencing a miscarriage.
To ensure welfare for female beneficiaries or wives of male beneficiaries under the Board.
To offer assistance for up to two miscarriage incidents during a beneficiary's lifetime.

benefits.description: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 for miscarriage, allowed up to two times in a beneficiary's lifetime.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of West Bengal, registered building/construction workers aged 18-60, and have worked at least 90 days in a year. For the scheme, the applicant must be a registered female member or wife of a male member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and have experienced a miscarriage.
schemes.application_process:
1. Request Form-27 (for registration) or Form-XII (for scheme application) from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
2. Attach all mandatory self-attested documents.
3. Submit the application to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
4. For registration, pay a ₹20 registration fee and ₹30 yearly subscription.
5. Renew subscription yearly with Form-27A and a ₹30 fee.

documents_required.name: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Old Age Pension
schemes.description: The Old Age Pension scheme, launched by the West Bengal state government in 2010, provides financial assistance to eligible senior citizens. It targets individuals aged 60 years and above who are unable to work and earn a living. The initiative aims to support the elderly and ensure their social welfare.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to senior citizens in West Bengal.
To support elderly individuals who are unable to work and earn a living.
To ensure social welfare and income security for vulnerable older residents.

benefits.description: Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹1,000.

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be residents of West Bengal for at least ten years. They should be 60 years or older, though the age limit is 55 for physically and mentally handicapped individuals. Applicants must not have any relation capable of providing financial support, should not exceed a monthly income of ₹1,000, and must not be receiving any other government pension.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the Application Form (Form-P) free of cost from the Block Development Officer (rural areas), Sub-Divisional Officer (municipal/notified areas), or Controller of Vagrancy (Kolkata Municipal Corporation areas).
2. Address the application form to the District Magistrate of the concerned District (for rural/municipal areas) or the Controller of Vagrancy, West Bengal (for Kolkata KMC areas).
3. Submit the completed application form to the respective office from where it was obtained.
4. For any queries, District Nodal Officers can be contacted.
schemes.ministry: Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department

schemes.scheme_name: Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers Under Coop. Fold
schemes.description: This scheme, implemented by the Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal, provides monthly financial assistance to eligible handloom weavers. It targets elderly weavers who are members of a handloom cooperative society and are unable to earn their livelihood. The objective is to offer a pension to support them in their old age.
objectives: To provide monthly financial assistance in the form of pension to eligible beneficiaries.
To support weaver members of handloom cooperative societies in their old age.
To assist incapacitated weavers who lack other income sources or family support.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1000.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society and have worked for at least 10 years under the cooperative society. They should not have any source of income, be in a position to earn their livelihood, or have any relation who can maintain them. The applicant must be permanently incapacitated for work due to physical or mental infirmity and should not have availed any pension from the State Government or Government of India.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the application form free of cost from the office of the Handloom Development Officer of the area where the applicant resides.
2. Address the application for pension to the Handloom Development Officer with all the required documents.

documents_required.name: Proof of being a member of a handloom cooperative society

schemes.ministry: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: Pension Benefit
schemes.description: The 'Pension Benefit' scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, provides financial assistance to registered workers upon reaching 60 years of age with at least 5 years of service. It also offers a family pension to the spouse or nominee in case of the beneficiary's death. This welfare scheme aims to support construction workers and their families in West Bengal.
objectives: To provide financial assistance in the form of a pension to registered building and construction workers.
To ensure financial security for registered members upon completion of 60 years of age and 5 years of service.
To extend support to the families of deceased beneficiaries through a family pension.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance provided to registered workers upon reaching 60 years of age.
Financial assistance provided to the spouse or nominee of a deceased beneficiary.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, West Bengal, who has completed 60 years of age and served the board for at least 5 years. For family pension, the applicant must be the spouse or nominee of a deceased beneficiary.
schemes.application_process:
1. To register as a worker, request Form-27 from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
2. Submit Form-27 with mandatory documents (photographs, age proof) to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
3. For the welfare scheme application, a registered worker should request Form-XXXVII from Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.
4. Submit the completed Form-XXXVII along with mandatory documents (Identity Card, Dependent/Heirship Certificate if applicable) to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/Beneficiary Registering Officers.

documents_required.name: Passport size photographs of the worker (Four copies)
Attested copy of Proof of Age
Dependent/ Heirship Certificate (In case the applicant is spouse/ nominee of the beneficiary)

schemes.ministry: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

schemes.scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement
schemes.description: The West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme provides financial assistance to unorganised transport workers or their nominees/dependents. It offers monetary compensation for accidental or natural death and graded benefits for permanent disabilities. The scheme aims to provide social security during times of distress.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to unorganised transport workers in West Bengal.
To offer monetary compensation to nominees/dependents in case of the worker's death.
To provide graded benefits for permanent disabilities incurred by transport workers.

benefits.description: Financial relief for accidental death of an enrolled transport worker.
Financial relief for natural death of an enrolled transport worker.
For loss of one hand, one leg below the knee, one eye, or hearing capacity in one ear.
For loss of a thumb (₹9,000), any other finger (₹4,000), with a maximum of ₹50,000 for total disablement.

eligibility.occupation: Unorganized transport worker (e.g., car, taxi, auto-rickshaw, lorry, bus driver)

schemes.eligibility_description: Applicants must be unorganized transport workers in West Bengal, aged between 18 and 60 years at the time of enrolment. Their commercial vehicle must be used for commercial purposes, not solely personal or family use. Nominees/dependents are eligible for benefits in case of the worker's death.
schemes.application_process:

2. Click on “Register” and fill in all details to create an account.

schemes.scheme_name: Widow Pension-West Bengal
schemes.description: Launched in 2010 by the West Bengal state government, the Widow Pension scheme provides financial support to widows. This compassionate initiative aims to assist women facing economic hardship within the state. It is managed by the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to eligible widows in West Bengal.
To support economically vulnerable women after the loss of their spouse.
To ensure a basic income for eligible widows through direct benefit transfer.

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- provided through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.

schemes.eligibility_description: The beneficiary must be a widow, a citizen of India, and a resident of West Bengal for at least ten years on the date of application. The beneficiary must not be maintained by any relative and professional beggars or mendicants are not eligible. Applicants already receiving another pension scheme are also excluded.
schemes.application_process:
1. Obtain the application form (Form-P) free of cost from the Block Development Officer (rural areas), Sub-Divisional Officer (municipal/notified areas), or Controller of Vagrancy (Kolkata Municipal Corporation).
2. Fill in personal details, contact information, bank account details, and type of disability (if applicable).
3. Attach all required documents, including self-attested copies of Aadhaar, Ration Card, Voter ID, Income Certificate, Husband’s Death Certificate, Bank Passbook, Nomination Form (if applicable), and a Passport Size photograph.
4. Submit the completed application form to the respective Block Development Officer/Executive Officer, Sub-Divisional Officer, or Controller of Vagrancy, addressed to the concerned District Magistrate or Controller of Vagrancy.

schemes.scheme_name: Gatidhara Scheme
schemes.description: The Gatidhara Scheme, launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal, aims to generate self-employment for registered unemployed youth in the state's transport sector. It provides financial support for purchasing commercial vehicles to promote transport services in urban and rural areas. Families with a monthly income of ₹25,000 or less are eligible for this scheme.
objectives: To generate self-employment in the Urban and Rural areas of West Bengal.
To promote transport services across the state.
To facilitate employment of registered unemployed youth in the transport sector.

benefits.description: A subsidy of 30% of the ex-showroom price of a commercial vehicle, subject to a maximum of ₹1,00,000, will be provided to beneficiaries.

schemes.eligibility_description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal, aged between 25 and 45 years (with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC), and enrolled in the Employment Bank of the Labour Department. The family's monthly income must be less than ₹25,000, and only one member per family is eligible.
schemes.application_process:
1. Register in the Employment Bank of the Labour Department by visiting https://employmentbankwb.gov.in/index.php.
2. Click on “New Enrolment Job Seeker”, accept terms, and fill in all mandatory details.
3. Get your application and requisite documents processed by the vehicle dealer of your choice.
4. Select a financier for the loan required to purchase the vehicle.
5. Register the vehicle within one month of receiving the offer letter for permit and subsidy.
